\chapter{Foundations}

\begin{axiom}[ax:obs]
\label{ax:obs}
There is a set $\Obs$, the observation space, whose elements are arbitrary finite records; $\Obs$ carries no decidable semantics.
\end{axiom}

\begin{construction}[con:denial]
\label{con:denial}
$D=(\{0,1\}^n,\lor,\bm0)$ is the commutative idempotent monoid of denial words; the total denial of an observation is $d(o)=\bigvee_i d_i(o)$, and $\adm(o)\neq\Rfsl\iff d(o)=\bm0$.
\end{construction}

\begin{corollary}[cor:antibody]
\label{cor:antibody}
Under \BRCE\ the overclaim set (actuations lacking a valid receipt) is empty as an invariant: the admissible magnitude of any claim is bounded by what the mechanism can receipt.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:noadmit]
\label{cor:noadmit}
There is no algorithm that admits an observation by deciding a non-trivial semantic property of what it denotes; any total admission procedure decides a syntactic, decidable surrogate instead.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:subcat]
\label{cor:subcat}
The sub-category of admissible morphisms a program may actually perform is precisely $\Life$; illegal-transition-is-a-type-error is a static fact about inhabited hom-sets, not a runtime check.
\end{corollary}

\begin{definition}[def:adm]
\label{def:adm}
Fix a decidable sub-collection $\Adm\subseteq\Obs$ and a finite battery of total, computable obligations $g_1,\dots,g_m$; the admission map $\adm$ is the partial retraction sending $o$ to $\rho(o)\in\Adm$ if all $g_i(o)=1$, else to $\Rfsl$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:brce]
\label{def:brce}
A system satisfies the Bounded Receipted Chatman Equation if for every actuated artifact it maintains the admission gate (B1), bounded manufacture (B2), receipt totality (B3), and conformance (B4).
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fit]
\label{def:fit}
Conformance fitness $\Fitness\in[0,1]$ is one minus the fraction of tokens a replay was forced to consume on unenabled lifecycle transitions; $\Fitness=1$ iff the replay never attempted a disabled firing.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:five]
\label{def:five}
The Chatman equation relates five objects: the observation space $\Obs$, the admitted space $\Adm$, the manufacturing morphism $\muop$, the artifact/action space $\Act$, and the receipt space $\Rec$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:lifecat]
\label{def:lifecat}
$\Life$ is the free category on the linear quiver $\Raw\xrightarrow{j}\Val\xrightarrow{a}\Admd\xrightarrow{r}\Rcpt$, with four objects and three generating arrows judge, admit, receipt.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:mu]
\label{def:mu}
A manufacturing morphism is a deterministic computable map $\muop:\Adm\to\Act$ satisfying determinism/reproducibility (M1) and boundedness (M2); $\muop$ is undefined off $\Adm$ and $\muop(\Rfsl)=\Rfsl$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:receipt]
\label{def:receipt}
Fix a collision-resistant hash $\chainH$; the frame is $\mathsf{fr}=\langle\theta,\chainH(b)\rangle$ and the chained receipt is $h_{+}=\chainH(h_{-}\Vert\mathsf{fr})$; the receipt is the $\le\CL$-chunk tuple (verdict, $h_+$, $\Fitness$, reason).
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:seqtoken]
\label{def:seqtoken}
The lifecycle process is modeled as a safe Petri net (3-Node SEQ POWL token game) over the marking $M=(\code{TOK\_START},\code{TOK\_JUDGED},\code{TOK\_ADMITTED},\code{TOK\_DONE})$, with fitness $\Fitness\in[0,1]$ in Q16.16.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:taxonomy]
\label{def:taxonomy}
A refusal taxonomy is a pair $(S,\mathrm{cat})$ where $S$ is a finite set of concrete refusal scenarios and $\mathrm{cat}:S\to C$ is a total map onto the eight-element category set $C$.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[lem:commit]
\label{lem:commit}
Under collision resistance of $\chainH$, the chain value $h_+$ is a binding commitment to $(h_-,\mathsf{fr})$; by induction $h_+$ binds the entire causal prefix.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proposition}[prop:hom]
\label{prop:hom}
For stages $X,Y$ of $\Life$, the hom-set $\Life(X,Y)$ has exactly one element if $Y$ is reachable from $X$ along the quiver, and is empty otherwise.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:mudet]
\label{prop:mudet}
Under (M1), $x\mapsto\muop(x)$ is single-valued, so $o\mapsto\muop(\adm(o))$ is a partial function on $\Obs$: two runs on the same admitted input agree bit-for-bit.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:retract]
\label{prop:retract}
$\adm$ restricted to $\Adm$ is the identity, and $\adm\circ\adm=\adm$ as partial maps; hence $\Adm$ is a retract of $\dom(\adm)$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:semilattice]
\label{prop:semilattice}
$(\{0,1\}^n,\lor,\bm0)$ is a bounded join-semilattice; consequently adding obligations can only enlarge the denial, never shrink it.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:total]
\label{prop:total}
The category map $\mathrm{cat}:S\to C$ is total (enforced by the host type system's exhaustive match), and the lane map's single-lane inverse is a section of the lane map over the seven named lanes.
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[thm:conservation]
\label{thm:conservation}
Under \BRCE, the map $a\mapsto h_+(a)$ from actuated artifacts to receipt-chain positions is well defined and injective up to hash collision, and every actuated artifact is the image under $\muop$ of exactly one admitted observation.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:rice]
\label{thm:rice}
Rice's theorem, specialized to observations: for any non-trivial semantic property $P$ of the function an observation denotes, the set $\{o\in\Obs : P(o)\}$ is undecidable.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:typestate]
\label{thm:typestate}
Interpreting each lifecycle stage as a LawObject type family, the exposed stage-changing operations denote exactly the generating arrows of $\Life$; every well-typed stage-changing program is a composite of $j,a,r$, illegal transitions are uninhabited hom-sets, and no law object can be receipted twice.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:antibody}]
(B3) requires a receipt per actuation; an actuation without one violates \BRCE\ and is, by (B1)'s gate, never emitted, so the set of receiptless actuations is empty. \hfill \textit{(by def:brce)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:noadmit}]
A total admission deciding a non-trivial semantic property would be a decider for an undecidable set; a total terminating procedure exists only for decidable predicates, the largest such structure being a decidable sub-collection onto which admission maps. \hfill \textit{(by thm:rice)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:subcat}]
Combining that the inhabited stage-changing types are exactly the morphisms of $\Life$ and the uninhabited ones are exactly the empty hom-sets, the admissible sub-category is $\Life$ itself, verified statically. \hfill \textit{(by thm:typestate)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{lem:commit}]
If $\chainH(h_-\Vert\mathsf{fr})=\chainH(h_-'\Vert\mathsf{fr}')$ for distinct arguments, the two arguments are a collision of $\chainH$, occurring with negligible probability under collision resistance. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
Since $h_-$ is itself such a commitment to the previous frame, induction on chain length shows $h_+$ commits to every frame in the prefix. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:hom}]
In the free category on a quiver, morphisms are directed paths; the quiver here is a simple directed path with no branches or cycles, so between any two vertices there is at most one directed path, giving singleton or empty hom-sets. \hfill \textit{(by def:lifecat)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:mudet}]
(M1) is exactly single-valuedness; composing the partial function $\adm$ with the function $\muop$ yields a partial function, and bit-identity of outputs on equal inputs is the contrapositive of disagreement implying differing input. \hfill \textit{(by def:mu)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:retract}]
For $x\in\Adm$ every $g_i(x)=1$ by construction, so $\adm(x)=\rho(x)=x$, i.e.\ $\adm|_\Adm=\id_\Adm$. \hfill \textit{(by def:adm)}\\
For general $o$ with $\adm(o)\neq\Rfsl$, $\adm(o)\in\Adm$, whence $\adm(\adm(o))=\adm(o)$; idempotence follows on all of $\dom(\adm)$. \hfill \textit{(by def:adm)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:semilattice}]
Idempotence, commutativity, and associativity of $\lor$ hold coordinatewise, so a product of semilattices is a semilattice with $\bm0$ the identity. \hfill \textit{(by con:denial)}\\
If $G'\supseteq G$ then $d_{G'}(o)\succeq d_G(o)$ coordinatewise, and since $\bm0$ is the unique minimum, $\{o:d_{G'}(o)=\bm0\}\subseteq\{o:d_G(o)=\bm0\}$: adding obligations only shrinks the admitted set. \hfill \textit{(by con:denial)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:total}]
Totality of a wildcard-free exhaustive match over a closed enum is exactly the compiler's exhaustiveness guarantee, so $\mathrm{cat}$ denotes a total function $S\to C$. \hfill \textit{(by def:taxonomy)}\\
The section identity is the round-trip property: for each of the seven single-lane constants $\ell$, $\mathrm{scn}(\ell)$ is defined and $\mathrm{lane}(\mathrm{scn}(\ell))=\ell$; a composed multi-lane word has no single scenario, per the denial monoid's join structure. \hfill \textit{(by con:denial)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:conservation}]
By (B1) actuation implies $a=\muop(x)$ with $x=\adm(o)\neq\Rfsl$, so $\im\muop$ is the whole actuated set and its complement is never actuated. \hfill \textit{(by def:brce)}\\
By (B2)/(M1), $x\mapsto\muop(x)$ is single-valued, so each actuated $a$ has a determined admitted preimage $x$. \hfill \textit{(by prop:mudet)}\\
By (B3) the actuation appends exactly one chain position, so $a\mapsto h_+(a)$ is a well-defined total map; injectivity up to collision follows because two distinct actuations sharing a chain value would collide under $\chainH$. \hfill \textit{(by lem:commit)}\\
Order preservation is the recursive dependence of $h_+$ on $h_-$ in the chain equation. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:rice}]
This is Rice's theorem instantiated at $\Obs$: a decider for $\{o:P(o)\}$ would decide the halting problem via the reduction $o_{M,x}$, a contradiction. \hfill \textit{(by thm:rice)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:typestate}]
The only public constructor produces a Raw object and the only public stage-changing operations are judge, admit, receipt, whose types are $j,a,r$; the stage-rebuilding helper is crate-private, so every externally well-typed stage-changing program is a composite of $j,a,r$, i.e.\ a morphism of $\Life$. \hfill \textit{(by prop:hom)}\\
If $\Life(X,Y)=\varnothing$ there is no path $X\to Y$ in the quiver, so no composite of $j,a,r$ has the required type; concretely receipt is impl'd only on Admitted and admit takes Validated by value, so the mismatched call is a type error. \hfill \textit{(by prop:hom)}\\
receipt takes self by value, consuming the Admitted object, and the returned Receipted type has no further stage-changing method, so a second receipting is both unconstructible and unavailable. \hfill \textit{(by def:lifecat)}\\
\end{proof}


\chapter{Admission Algebra}

\begin{axiom}[ax:refusal]
\label{ax:refusal}
There is a distinguished refusal value $\Rfsl$ and a space of reasons $\mathcal{R}_{\!f}$; a refusal is not the absence of an output but the pair $(\Rfsl,r)$ with $r\in\mathcal{R}_{\!f}$ a machine-checkable reason, so admission is total as a map into $\Adm\cup(\{\Rfsl\}\times\mathcal{R}_{\!f})$.
\end{axiom}

\begin{corollary}[cor:allstages]
\label{cor:allstages}
$\Phi_o(w)=\Adml\iff\varphi_o(s_i)=\Adml$ for every stage $s_i$ in $w$; a single refusing stage refuses the whole pipeline, and the aggregate word records every lane that fired anywhere along $w$.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:assembled]
\label{cor:assembled}
Composing the total maps of prop:obtotal and prop:section with the total classification of thm:total: every unmet obligation (via $\catop\circ\scnop$) and every non-$\Adml$ single denial lane (via $\catop\circ\scnop_\ell$ on $L\setminus\{\Adml\}$) maps to exactly one of the seven inhabited categories; no obligation failure and no fired single lane is left unclassified.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:galois]
\label{cor:galois}
The assignment $G\mapsto\Adm_G$ is an order-reversing map from $(2^{\mathcal{G}},\subseteq)$ to $(2^{\Obs},\subseteq)$: $G\subseteq G'\Rightarrow\Adm_{G'}\subseteq\Adm_G$; the empty obligation set admits everything ($\Adm_\varnothing=\Obs$), and enlarging obligations monotonically tightens the gate.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:mrrindep]
\label{cor:mrrindep}
thm:mrrsep holds exactly when no obligation in $G_{\mathrm{prop}}$ couples distinct accounts; if such coupling exists, the proposer's obligation battery must be extended with a BlockingConstraint on the shared resource, which by thm:mono only tightens the admitted set and preserves the denial algebra.
\end{corollary}

\begin{definition}[def:decoder]
\label{def:decoder}
Let $L=\{\Adml,c_1,\dots,c_7\}\subseteq\Deny$ be the clean word together with the seven named single-lane constants; the lane decoder $\scnop_\ell:\Deny\rightharpoonup\Scnset$ is scenario\_for\_denial\_lane: it returns None on $\Adml$, returns the matching denial-lane scenario on each $c_i$, and returns None on every word not in $L$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:denialabstract]
\label{def:denialabstract}
Fix $n\in\mathbb{N}$ lanes; the abstract denial word space is $\Deny_n=\{0,1\}^{n}$ with componentwise disjunction $\lor$ and the all-zero word $\bm 0$; lane $i$ is set in $d$ when $d_i=1$, $\supp d=\{i:d_i=1\}$, and $d\preceq d'$ means $\forall i\,(d_i\le d_i')$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:denialcode]
\label{def:denialcode}
In praxis the denial word is DenialPolarity, a repr(transparent) newtype over u64 carved into eight byte-lanes; the clean word is $\Adml=$ DenialPolarity(0); seven named nonzero constants each occupy one distinct byte lane; the product is compose$(a,b)=$ DenialPolarity$(a.0\mathbin{|}b.0)$, bitwise OR; the admission predicate is is\_admitted$(d)\iff d.0=0$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fired]
\label{def:fired}
$\firedmap:\Deny\to\{0,1\}^{8}$ sends a word $d$ to the bit vector whose bit $j$ equals the nonzero-indicator of byte lane $j$ of $d$: $\firedmap(d)_j=\mathbf 1[(d.0\gg 8j)\ \&\ \text{0xFF}\ne 0]$, computed branchlessly via $\mathbf 1[x\ne 0]=(x\mathbin{|}(-x))\gg 63$ on each lane.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:logicadm]
\label{def:logicadm}
prolog8 admits a query, fact block, or rule only if it lies in a bounded, decidable Horn fragment: arity $\le 8$, rule body $\le 8$ atoms, $\le 8$ variables, proof fan-in $\le 8$; no cut, no dynamic mutation, stratified negation, bounded recursion, no runtime text parsing, no side effects, interned terms; violations are enumerated by RejectionCode.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:mrr]
\label{def:mrr}
Let $A$ be a set of client accounts; for each $a\in A$ let $\mathrm{lawful\_targets}(a)$ be the evidence-gated target stages and $\mathrm{realized}(a,s)$ the revenue function under stage $s$; the Maximum Reachable Revenue is $\mathrm{MRR}=\max_{\text{plan}}\sum_{a\in A}\mathrm{realized}(a)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:ob]
\label{def:ob}
An obligation is a first-class, hashable value the payload must satisfy before admission; the Obligation enum has exactly three kinds; each obligation $g$ induces a lane map $\delta_g:\Obs\to\Deny$ returning $\Adml$ if $g$ is satisfied by $o$, else $\ell(g)$; for a set $G$ the total denial is $d_G(o)=\bigvee_{i=1}^{m}\delta_{g_i}(o)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:obsauth]
\label{def:obsauth}
Let $\Obs$ be the raw observation space; an observation $o\in\Obs$ is authoritative ($o\in\Obs^{*}$) if it was produced by an admitted actuation with a chained receipt; all other observations are untrusted; the proposer's admission map $\adm_{\mathrm{prop}}$ retracts $\Obs$ onto $\Adm_{\mathrm{prop}}$ by treating every inbound observation as untrusted until its receipt chain satisfies the obligation battery $G_{\mathrm{prop}}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:pipeline]
\label{def:pipeline}
Let Stage be the set of admission stages; fix $o$ and let $\varphi_o:\text{Stage}\to\Deny$ send a stage to the denial word it emits on $o$; a pipeline is a finite sequence $w=s_1\cdots s_k\in\text{Stage}^{*}$, an element of the free monoid on Stage; its aggregate denial is $\Phi_o(w)=\bigvee_{i=1}^{k}\varphi_o(s_i)$, $\Phi_o(\varepsilon)=\Adml$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:queryresult]
\label{def:queryresult}
Kernel::query returns QueryResult, one of Answered(Vec<Decision>), Denied(Box<Decision>), or Invalid(RejectionCode); a Decision carries a proof (a Vec<ProofNode> DAG, positive or negative) and a receipt sufficient for deterministic replay.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:tax]
\label{def:tax}
The category set $\Catset$ is the eight-element enum Identity/Capacity/Topology/Temporal/Lifecycle/Authorization/Prerequisites/Reserved; the scenario set $\Scnset$ is the thirteen-variant RefusalScenario enum partitioned into three obligation-driven, seven denial-lane, and three logic/andon variants; the category map $\catop:\Scnset\to\Catset$ is RefusalScenario::category.
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:bottom]
\label{prop:bottom}
$\adm_G(o)\ne\Rfsl\iff d_G(o)=\Adml\iff$ every $g_i\in G$ is satisfied by $o$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:boundary]
\label{prop:boundary}
Under def:obsauth, praxis-proposer enforces $\im\muop_{\mathrm{prop}}\subseteq\Adm_{\mathrm{prop}}$: no proposal is manufactured from an unadmitted observation; the generic Domain<D> proposer evaluates its Obligation battery on every inbound record before calling Admit::admit, and a record failing any obligation is refused and never reaches manufacturing.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:boundedcert]
\label{prop:boundedcert}
Every proof node emitted by the kernel has fan-in $\le 8$ and every rule body has $\le 8$ atoms, so a proof is a bounded-degree DAG; its rolling proof\_root is a single fixed-width hash field of the receipt, and a bounded-context verifier checks a query outcome in $O(\CL)$ by recomputing proof\_root.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:code\_is\_sl]
\label{prop:code_is_sl}
$\Deny=(\{\text{DenialPolarity}\},\text{compose},\Adml)$ is a bounded commutative idempotent monoid, is\_admitted is exactly the predicate 'is the bottom element,' and the submonoid $\langle L\rangle$ generated by the seven named nonzero constants together with $\Adml$ is isomorphic to $\Deny_7$ via 'which named lanes are nonzero.'
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:embed]
\label{prop:embed}
The refusing branches of thm:trichotomy embed into $(\Deny,\text{compose},\Adml)$ via the taxonomy: run\_kernel\_query maps Denied to scenario KernelDenied (category Authorization) and Invalid to KernelInvalid (category Identity); by denial\_lane both compose into lane CONFORMANCE\_GATE\_FAILED, so a logical refusal is subject to monotonicity, classification, pipeline composition, and fired-mask projection exactly as any obligation refusal.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:fleet]
\label{prop:fleet}
Let a fleet of $N$ manufactures produce aggregate words $\Phi^{(1)},\dots,\Phi^{(N)}$, packed as $b^{(r)}=\firedmap(\Phi^{(r)})\in\{0,1\}^{8}$; then $\firedmap(\Phi_o(w))=\bigvee_i\firedmap(\varphi_o(s_i))$, and a fleet admission sweep is one linear pass computing $\bigvee_r b^{(r)}$, returning $\bm 0$ iff every agent is admitted.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:monoid]
\label{prop:monoid}
$(\Deny_n,\lor,\bm 0)$ is a commutative monoid in which every element is idempotent; it is the join-semilattice of the Boolean lattice $(2^{[n]},\subseteq)$ under $d\mapsto\supp d$, with $\bm 0$ least and $\bm 1$ greatest, so $d\lor d'$ is the least upper bound and $\preceq$ is exactly $d\preceq d'\iff d\lor d'=d'$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:obtotal]
\label{prop:obtotal}
The map $\scnop:\text{Obligation}\to\Scnset$ implemented by From<\&Obligation> for RefusalScenario is a total function realized by a wildcard-free match over the three Obligation kinds; because the match has no wildcard arm, totality is a static property of the program, not a runtime hope.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:partial]
\label{prop:partial}
$\scnop_\ell$ is a partial map, definite (as Some) only on $L\setminus\{\Adml\}$; it is not realizable as a wildcard-free exhaustive match because its domain $\Deny$ is an open value space of cardinality $2^{64}$, not a closed enum, so exhaustiveness over the seven single lanes is a runtime test obligation, not a static type obligation.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:section]
\label{prop:section}
The lane encoder $\laneop:\Scnset\to\Deny$ implemented by denial\_lane is total via a wildcard-free match over all thirteen scenarios; restricted to the seven denial-lane scenarios $\Scnset_\ell$, it and $\scnop_\ell$ form a section-retraction pair, so the seven single lanes and the seven denial-lane scenarios are in bijection; the remaining six scenarios map onto closest-fit lanes and are not in that bijection's range.
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[thm:firedhom]
\label{thm:firedhom}
$\firedmap$ is a homomorphism of bounded commutative idempotent monoids: $\firedmap(\Adml)=\bm 0$ and $\firedmap(\text{compose}(a,b))=\firedmap(a)\lor\firedmap(b)$ for all $a,b\in\Deny$; restricted to $\langle L\rangle$ it is a monoid isomorphism onto the seven-bit image $\{0\}\times\{0,1\}^{7}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:freehom]
\label{thm:freehom}
$\Phi_o:(\text{Stage}^{*},\cdot,\varepsilon)\to(\Deny,\text{compose},\Adml)$ is the unique monoid homomorphism extending $\varphi_o$ along $\text{Stage}\hookrightarrow\text{Stage}^{*}$; because the target is commutative and idempotent, $\Phi_o(w)$ depends only on the set of distinct stage-denials occurring in $w$, invariant under reordering and repetition.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:mono]
\label{thm:mono}
Let $G\subseteq G'$ be obligation sets; then $d_G(o)\preceq d_{G'}(o)$ for every observation $o$, hence $\Adm_{G'}\subseteq\Adm_G$: adding obligations can only enlarge denial and shrink admission, never admit an observation a smaller obligation set refused.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:mrrsep]
\label{thm:mrrsep}
If the accounts in $A$ are independent, then $\mathrm{MRR}=\sum_{a\in A}\max_{s\in\mathrm{lawful\_targets}(a)}\mathrm{realized}(a,s)$, reducing the joint plan search from exponential to linear in $|\mathrm{lawful\_targets}(a)|$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:total]
\label{thm:total}
The category map $\catop:\Scnset\to\Catset$ is total (every one of the thirteen scenarios has exactly one category), mechanized (compiler-certified via a wildcard-free match), and its image is $\Catset\setminus\{\text{Reserved}\}$: exactly seven buckets are inhabited, and Reserved has empty preimage.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:trichotomy]
\label{thm:trichotomy}
For a query $q$ evaluated against an admitted kernel, exactly one of Answered (a positive proof DAG with fan-in $\le 8$ plus receipt), Denied (a negative proof plus receipt), or Invalid (a RejectionCode, no proof) holds.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:allstages}]
A join in a join-semilattice equals the bottom iff every joinand is the bottom; apply to $\Phi_o(w)=\bigvee_i\varphi_o(s_i)$; the support of the aggregate is $\supp\Phi_o(w)=\bigcup_i\supp\varphi_o(s_i)$, the union of the per-stage fired lanes. \hfill \textit{(by prop:monoid)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:assembled}]
Immediate by composition of the three total (respectively Some-total) maps, each single-valued into its codomain, landing in $\im\catop=\Catset\setminus\{\text{Reserved}\}$. \hfill \textit{(by thm:total)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:galois}]
Order-reversal is thm:mono; with $G=\varnothing$ the join is empty, so $d_\varnothing(o)=\Adml$ for all $o$ and $\Adm_\varnothing=\Obs$. \hfill \textit{(by thm:mono)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:mrrindep}]
Immediate from thm:mono: adding an obligation enlarges denial and shrinks admission; with the extended battery the coupled accounts are refused by the coupling constraint and the remaining independent ones decompose additively as before. \hfill \textit{(by thm:mono)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:bottom}]
$d_G(o)=\bigvee_i\delta_{g_i}(o)=\Adml$ iff every summand is $\Adml$ (a join of elements of a join-semilattice equals the bottom iff each element is the bottom), i.e.\ iff no obligation is unmet; admission returns non-refusal exactly in that case. \hfill \textit{(by prop:monoid)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:boundary}]
The Domain struct holds a Law<Obligation> attached to its typed domain D; proposing calls judge then admit in sequence, and an Andon::Halted on either step returns the Err branch with its denial word; the manufacturing step is unreachable from the Err branch, so $\im\muop_{\mathrm{prop}}$ is contained in Admitted objects. \hfill \textit{(by def:obsauth)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:boundedcert}]
Fan-in and body caps are enforced by admit\_rule, so proof nodes have bounded out-degree; the receipt commits the proof by its root hash, and replay recomputes the root from the stored decision, agreeing iff untampered; the verifier reads the fixed-width root, not the DAG, so its cost is $O(\CL)$. \hfill \textit{(by def:logicadm)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:code_is_sl}]
Bitwise OR on u64 is associative, commutative, idempotent, with identity the zero word; compose inherits these, so $\Deny$ is a bounded commutative idempotent monoid whose bottom is $\Adml$, and is\_admitted$(d)\iff d.0=0\iff d=\Adml$. \hfill \textit{(by def:denialcode)}\\
Each named constant $c_i$ ($1\le i\le 7$) occupies lane $i$ alone, so for any subset $S\subseteq\{1,\dots,7\}$ the composite $\bigvee_{i\in S}c_i$ has byte lane $i$ nonzero iff $i\in S$; the map $\bigvee_{i\in S}c_i\mapsto\bm 1_S\in\Deny_7$ is a well-defined bijection $\langle L\rangle\to\Deny_7$ carrying compose to $\lor$ and $\Adml$ to $\bm 0$: a monoid isomorphism. \hfill \textit{(by prop:monoid)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:embed}]
run\_kernel\_query constructs RefusalScenario::KernelDenied on the Denied branch and RefusalScenario::KernelInvalid on the Invalid branch; their categories are as stated by thm:total, and denial\_lane sends both to CONFORMANCE\_GATE\_FAILED; being elements of $\Deny$, they are acted on by all the structure of the preceding chapters. \hfill \textit{(by thm:total)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:fleet}]
$\firedmap$ is a homomorphism and $\Phi_o$ is a homomorphism; their composite carries compose to $\lor$, so $\firedmap(\bigvee_i\varphi_o(s_i))=\bigvee_i\firedmap(\varphi_o(s_i))$. \hfill \textit{(by thm:firedhom)}\\
The pass folds $\lor$ over $N$ bytes; by cor:allstages applied fleet-wide, the fold is $\bm 0$ iff each $b^{(r)}=\bm 0$ iff each aggregate is $\Adml$ iff every agent is admitted, and packing eight bytes per machine word makes the fold word-parallel. \hfill \textit{(by cor:allstages)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:monoid}]
Disjunction is associative, commutative, and idempotent per coordinate, with unit $0$ per coordinate; a finite product of such structures inherits all four laws, giving a bounded commutative idempotent monoid; the map $d\mapsto\supp d$ carries $\lor$ to $\cup$ and $\bm 0$ to $\varnothing$, and is a bijection $\Deny_n\to 2^{[n]}$, hence a monoid isomorphism onto $(2^{[n]},\cup,\varnothing)$. \hfill \textit{(by def:denialabstract)}\\
In any join-semilattice the identity $d\preceq d'\iff d\lor d'=d'$ holds by antisymmetry of $\subseteq$; least/greatest elements are $\varnothing$ and $[n]$, i.e.\ $\bm 0$ and $\bm 1$. \hfill \textit{(by prop:monoid)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:obtotal}]
A Rust match on a closed enum type-checks only if every constructor is covered or a wildcard is present; the cited match covers all three constructors and uses no wildcard, so the compiler certifies exhaustiveness, and each arm returns a specific RefusalScenario, so $\scnop$ is a total function. \hfill \textit{(by def:ob)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:partial}]
Rust's exhaustiveness checker operates on closed sum types; a newtype over u64 exposes $2^{64}$ inhabitants with no finite constructor set, so no wildcard-free match on its value is well-typed --- the implementation is necessarily an if/else chain over the eight known constants with a None fallback, returning None on $\Adml$, Some on each $c_i$, and None on any other word, including every $c_i\lor c_j$ with $i\ne j$. \hfill \textit{(by def:decoder)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:section}]
$\laneop$ matches all thirteen constructors with no wildcard, hence is total, by the same mechanism as thm:total; for each of the seven denial-lane scenarios $s$, $\laneop(s)=c_i$ is its own lane, and $\scnop_\ell(c_i)=s$, giving $\scnop_\ell(\laneop(s))=s$; conversely $\laneop(\scnop_\ell(c_i))=\laneop(s)=c_i$. \hfill \textit{(by thm:total)}\\
Both round-trips are the identity on their respective seven-element sets; the six non-lane scenarios map by $\laneop$ onto lanes already claimed by the seven, so $\laneop$ is not injective overall and those six are outside the bijection. \hfill \textit{(by def:decoder)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:firedhom}]
$\firedmap(\Adml)=\bm 0$ since every lane of the zero word is zero; byte lane $j$ of compose$(a,b)=a.0\mathbin{|}b.0$ is $a_j\mathbin{|}b_j$, and for byte values $\mathbf 1[a_j\mathbin{|}b_j\ne 0]=\mathbf 1[a_j\ne 0]\lor\mathbf 1[b_j\ne 0]$, so $\firedmap$ satisfies the claimed homomorphism law lane by lane. \hfill \textit{(by def:fired)}\\
On $\langle L\rangle$, prop:code\_is\_sl identifies elements with subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\dots,7\}$, and $\firedmap$ sends such an element to the indicator of $S$ in bits $1\ldots7$; this is a bijection onto $\{0\}\times\{0,1\}^{7}$ preserving join and bottom. \hfill \textit{(by prop:code\_is\_sl)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:freehom}]
$\Phi_o(\varepsilon)=\Adml$ and $\Phi_o(w\cdot w')=\bigvee_{s\in w}\varphi_o(s)\lor\bigvee_{s\in w'}\varphi_o(s)=\Phi_o(w)\lor\Phi_o(w')=\text{compose}(\Phi_o(w),\Phi_o(w'))$ by associativity of $\lor$; so $\Phi_o$ is a monoid homomorphism agreeing with $\varphi_o$ on length-one words, and uniqueness is the universal property of the free monoid. \hfill \textit{(by def:pipeline)}\\
Commutativity gives order-independence ($a\lor b=b\lor a$) and idempotence gives multiplicity-independence ($a\lor a=a$), so $\Phi_o(w)=\bigvee_{s\in\mathrm{set}(w)}\varphi_o(s)$ depends only on the underlying set of distinct denials. \hfill \textit{(by prop:monoid)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:mono}]
$d_{G'}(o)=\bigvee_{g\in G'}\delta_g(o)=\bigl(\bigvee_{g\in G}\delta_g(o)\bigr)\lor\bigl(\bigvee_{g\in G'\setminus G}\delta_g(o)\bigr)=d_G(o)\lor d_{G'\setminus G}(o)\succeq d_G(o)$, since in a join-semilattice $x\preceq x\lor y$ always. \hfill \textit{(by prop:monoid)}\\
If $o\in\Adm_{G'}$ then $d_{G'}(o)=\Adml$, the bottom; from $d_G(o)\preceq d_{G'}(o)=\Adml$ and minimality of $\Adml$ we get $d_G(o)=\Adml$, i.e.\ $o\in\Adm_G$. \hfill \textit{(by prop:bottom)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:mrrsep}]
Independence means the feasibility of account $a$'s targets is unaffected by the targets of any $b\neq a$; hence the joint optimization $\max_{\text{joint}}\sum_a r(a)$ decomposes into $\sum_a\max_{s_a}r(a,s_a)$ by linearity of the sum and independence of the maxima. \hfill \textit{(by def:mrr)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:total}]
A Rust match on the closed RefusalScenario enum type-checks only under exhaustiveness; the category method matches all thirteen constructors with no wildcard arm, so the compiler certifies that every scenario is assigned, and each arm returns a single RefusalCategory, making $\catop$ total and single-valued. \hfill \textit{(by def:tax)}\\
Reading the thirteen arms exhibits a preimage for each of the seven listed buckets, so all seven are in the image; and no arm returns Reserved, so $\catop^{-1}(\text{Reserved})=\varnothing$, hence $\im\catop$ is precisely the seven-element complement of $\{\text{Reserved}\}$. \hfill \textit{(by def:tax)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:trichotomy}]
Kernel::query's first action is the admission gate: if admit\_atom$(q)$ returns Err$(c)$ the kernel returns Invalid$(c)$ immediately, before any search, establishing case (c) and its no-proof clause. \hfill \textit{(by def:logicadm)}\\
Phase 1 scans fact blocks for rows unifying with $q$; a nonempty match set is assembled into Answered decisions, each with a positive proof rooted at the matched fact hash; Phase 2, on empty Phase 1, applies each rule whose head unifies with $q$ by depth-one backward chaining, giving case (a); the fan-in bound holds because admit\_rule rejects any node exceeding fan-in 8. \hfill \textit{(by def:queryresult)}\\
Phase 3 is reached iff both searches are empty; the kernel then assembles a Denied decision with a negative proof recording the exhausted search, giving case (b); the three phases are mutually exclusive by construction, so exactly one branch fires. \hfill \textit{(by def:queryresult)}\\
Soundness and completeness of the depth-bounded resolution --- that Phase 3 is reached only when $q$ is underivable within the fragment --- is SLD soundness and completeness for definite/stratified Horn programs, restricted to the finite search space the byte caps of def:logicadm guarantee. \hfill \textit{(by def:logicadm)}\\
\end{proof}


\chapter{Receipt Cryptography}

\begin{axiom}[ax:cr]
\label{ax:cr}
$\chainH$ (BLAKE3) is collision-resistant: no PPT adversary finds $x\ne y$ with $\chainH(x)=\chainH(y)$ except with negligible probability $\varepsilon(\lambda)$, $\lambda=256$, birthday bound $\sim 2^{128}$.
\end{axiom}

\begin{construction}[con:commit]
\label{con:commit}
Let $p\in\{0,1\}^{*}$ be the canonical JSON bytes of an admitted payload and $\dg(p)=\chainH(p)\in\{0,1\}^{256}$ its digest; partition $\dg(p)$ into eight $32$-bit little-endian words $w_0,\dots,w_7$ and set $\code{obj\_refs}[i]=\code{PackedObjRef}(w_i)$ via the raw tuple constructor, preserving all $32$ bits.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:ocel]
\label{con:ocel}
The map $\Omega:\Ledger\to\mathrm{OCEL2.0}$ sends each frame to an OCEL event with event id \code{instruction\_id}, activity the label of \code{activity\_idx}, timestamp \code{ts\_ns}, and E2O qualifiers to \code{object\_ids}.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:provo]
\label{con:provo}
Each receipt maps to a PROV-O shape: the admitted observation a \code{prov:Entity}, the manufacture a \code{prov:Activity} that used it, the artifact a \code{prov:Entity} generated by the activity, and the chain link a \code{prov:wasDerivedFrom} edge, SHACL-validated against \code{sr:SharedReceiptV1}.
\end{construction}

\begin{corollary}[cor:antibody]
\label{cor:antibody}
A claim of the form "this artifact is good because its receipt verifies" is an overclaim: it asserts a virtue Theorem~\ref{thm:scope} shows is not entailed. The admissible claim is the narrow conjunction of integrity, attribution, and conformance-as-checked.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:cost]
\label{cor:cost}
A verifier checking a single frame recomputes one fold and one equality test: $O(1)$ time and space, independent of $n$; checking the boundary projection of a whole run is $O(\CL)$.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:orphan]
\label{cor:orphan}
No actuated artifact lacks a chain position (no orphan) and no chain position is shared by two actuations (no double-count); consequence is neither created without an admitted cause nor recorded without a unique receipt slot.
\end{corollary}

\begin{definition}[def:body]
\label{def:body}
The hash body $\body(\fr)\in\{0,1\}^{8\cdot 99}$ is the $99$-byte serialization produced by \code{to\_hash\_bytes}; it is a total, injective function of the semantic fields of $\fr$ (all fields except the structural \code{pad}).
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:chain]
\label{def:chain}
For a frame $\fr$ with predecessor commitment $h_{-}$, the successor commitment is $h_{+}=\chainH(h_{-}\concat\body(\fr))$; a chain $\Ledger=(\fr_1,\dots,\fr_n)$ has $h_0=\Genesis$ and $h_t=\chainH(h_{t-1}\concat\body(\fr_t))$, terminal value $h_n$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:contentaddr]
\label{def:contentaddr}
The address of a stored object $b$ is $\code{content\_address}(b)=\chainH(b)$ in hex; two byte-identical objects share an address, any change yields a different address.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fitness]
\label{def:fitness}
Replay fitness is $\Fitness=1-\frac{\text{tokens forced on unenabled transitions}}{\text{tokens the replay attempted}}\in[0,1]$, represented as Q16.16 with unit $\code{0x0001\_0000}=65536$; the \code{token\_replay} stage accepts a record iff its replayed fitness equals that unit.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:frame]
\label{def:frame}
A frame $\fr$ is the record $\langle\code{instruction\_id}, \code{fired\_mask}, \code{denial}, \code{obj\_refs}[0{:}8], \code{ts\_ns}, \code{activity\_idx}, \code{node\_kind}, \code{prior\_hash}\rangle$, laid out as a $\code{repr(C, align(64))}$ structure occupying exactly $128$ bytes, with $5$ bytes of interior padding.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:genesis]
\label{def:genesis}
The genesis chain value is $\Genesis=\chainH(\bm 0_{32})$; a run may additionally bind a domain seed $\Genesis_{\mathrm{dom}}=\chainH(\text{project-version-genesis})$ so chains from distinct projects or versions cannot cross-verify.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:gitlock]
\label{def:gitlock}
An atomic CAS lock for resource $L$ at repository HEAD OID $H$ is acquired by \code{git update-ref refs/locks/}$L$ $H$ $\bm 0$, which fails if \code{refs/locks/}$L$ already exists and succeeds atomically otherwise via POSIX rename; deletion on drop releases the lock.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:gitlock-op]
\label{def:gitlock-op}
For named resource $L$ at HEAD OID $H$, the CAS lock is acquired by \code{git update-ref refs/locks/}$L$ $H$ $\bm 0_{20}$, atomically creating \code{refs/locks/}$L$ pointing to $H$ iff the reference is absent; deletion on drop releases the lock.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:pipeline]
\label{def:pipeline}
The validator runs five stages in fixed order over a ledger $(\fr_t)_{t=1}^{n}$ -- \code{schema}, \code{chain\_recompute}, \code{chain\_linkage}, \code{monotonic}, \code{token\_replay} -- each returning Pass/Fail/Skip, reporting all stage outcomes rather than short-circuiting.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:signed]
\label{def:signed}
A signed receipt is the triple $\code{SignedReceipt}=\langle h_{\mathrm{hex}}, s, k\rangle$ where $s=\mathrm{Sign}_{sk}(h_{\mathrm{hex}})$ is an Ed25519 signature and $k$ the hex verifying key; it is self-contained since $s$ and $k$ travel with $h_{\mathrm{hex}}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:bodyinj]
\label{prop:bodyinj}
$\body$ is injective on the semantic field tuple: if $\body(\fr)=\body(\fr')$ then $\fr$ and $\fr'$ agree on every field of Definition~\ref{def:frame}.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:cas]
\label{prop:cas}
In a content-addressed lake, storing the same receipt twice is idempotent, and mutating a stored receipt changes its address, so the old address still resolves to the old bytes: history is immutable by construction.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:failclosed]
\label{prop:failclosed}
When the \code{signed} feature is enabled, a missing or unreadable signing key is a hard error (\code{SigningFailed}), not a silent skip.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:fitness]
\label{prop:fitness}
A record's replay attains $\Fitness=\code{0x0001\_0000}$ iff its lifecycle is a genuine firing sequence of the fixed POWL token model; otherwise the first forced consumption localizes the nonconformant step, and the stage fails naming that record.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:fold]
\label{prop:fold}
$h_n$ is a deterministic function of $(\Genesis,\fr_1,\dots,\fr_n)$, computable by a single left fold; equal inputs give bit-identical $h_n$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:intauth]
\label{prop:intauth}
Integrity (\code{verify\_chain\_hash}) checks $s$ against the embedded key $k$; authenticity (\code{verify\_chain\_hash\_with\_key}) checks $s$ against an externally pinned key $k^{\star}$. The first is necessary but not sufficient for the second.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:mapcommit]
\label{prop:mapcommit}
$\Omega$ and the PROV-O bridge are lossless over the committed fields: the terminal $h_n$ is recoverable from the exported log's per-event fields, so exporting does not weaken the chain guarantee.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:nodrift]
\label{prop:nodrift}
A receipt emitted by \code{LawObject::receipt\_with\_record} and later recomputed by \code{ReceiptRecord::recompute\_chain\_hash} both route through \code{build\_admission\_frame} and \code{chain\_from\_frame}; for identical stored fields they compute identical $h_{+}$, so any disagreement is attributable to a changed stored field, never divergent code paths.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:notesledger]
\label{prop:notesledger}
The audit ledger is stored under \code{refs/notes/praxis/audit}; appending entries is a commit transition writing hash-chain receipts as NDJSON notes, preserving immutability of the execution timeline.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:notesledger-op]
\label{prop:notesledger-op}
Under the CAS lock of Definition~\ref{def:gitlock-op}, each append of a receipt record is a commit transition serialized as NDJSON under the annotated commit OID, immutable by Git's content-addressed object model, with concurrent appends serialized by the acquire-fail branch of the CAS.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:payloadcommit]
\label{prop:payloadcommit}
Under Construction~\ref{con:commit}, $\body(\fr)$ determines $\dg(p)$, and by Proposition~\ref{prop:bodyinj} any change to $\dg(p)$ changes $\body(\fr)$: a frame commits to the content of the artifact, not an opaque handle.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:prefix]
\label{prop:prefix}
For each $t$, $h_t$ commits every frame $\fr_1,\dots,\fr_t$ and the genesis value; the terminal $h_n$ commits the entire history.
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[thm:conservation]
\label{thm:conservation}
Fix $\Act=\muop(\Adm)$ with the receipt chain of Definition~\ref{def:chain}. Every actuated artifact is caused by an admitted $x\ne\Rfsl$; each actuation is positioned by exactly one appended frame, with $\Phi:\text{actuation}\mapsto h_{+}$ injective up to collision; each committed frame is attributed at least one admitted cause via bytes $[24,56)$ and $[16,24)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:faithful]
\label{thm:faithful}
Let $\Ledger=(\fr_1,\dots,\fr_n)$ have terminal commitment $h_n$, and $\Ledger'$ differ in at least one committed field of at least one frame; if $\Ledger'$ has the same terminal $h_n$, a collision of $\chainH$ has been exhibited. Under Axiom~\ref{ax:cr}, altering any committed field while preserving $h_n$ succeeds only with probability $\le\varepsilon(\lambda)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:localize]
\label{thm:localize}
Suppose a lawful ledger $\Ledger$ is perturbed to $\Ledger'$ with first affected record index $j$. The pipeline of Definition~\ref{def:pipeline} reports a Fail whose named record index is $j$, and the stage identifier names the class of fault; the honest prefix $\fr_1,\dots,\fr_{j-1}$ is not implicated.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:scope]
\label{thm:scope}
Let a receipt chain $\Ledger$ verify and optionally be authentically signed. Then $\Ledger$ establishes integrity, attribution, and conformance-as-checked, and no more: it does not establish obligation adequacy, world-fitness, or semantic truth.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:antibody}]
The broad claim entails world-fitness (b), which the Scope Theorem shows is independent of the verdict, so the broad claim is not supported by the receipt; the narrow claim is exactly the conjunction (A)$\wedge$(B)$\wedge$(C), each proven. \hfill \textit{(by thm:scope)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:cost}]
The fold reads two fixed-width operands and produces a $256$-bit output, constant work; equality on $256$-bit values is constant; the boundary projection has $\le\CL$ chunks by construction, so applying the boundary predicate is $O(\CL)$. Neither cost references $n$ or the interior dimension. \hfill \textit{(by thm:faithful)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:bodyinj}]
Each field occupies a disjoint, fixed byte range and each integer field's little-endian encoding is a bijection on its width; a byte-equal body forces range-wise, hence field-wise, equality. Pad bytes are absent from the body so frames differing only in padding correctly have equal bodies. \hfill \textit{(by def:body)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:cas}]
The address is $\chainH(b)$, a function of $b$; equal $b$ gives equal address. \hfill \textit{(by def:contentaddr)}\\
A change $b\to b'$ with $b\ne b'$ gives $\chainH(b')\ne\chainH(b)$ except on a collision, so the reference $\chainH(b)$ cannot be made to resolve to $b'$. \hfill \textit{(by ax:cr)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:failclosed}]
The \code{signed} feature exists to guarantee a signature; silently skipping would defeat its purpose and let an unsigned receipt masquerade as covered, so key absence is treated as failure: authenticity is either present and checkable or explicitly absent, never ambiguously assumed. \hfill \textit{(by def:signed)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:fitness}]
Enabled firings force no consumption, giving numerator $0$ and $\Fitness=1$; a disabled event forces a consumption, making the numerator positive and $\Fitness<1$ at the earliest offending index. The stage compares against the exact fixed-point unit. \hfill \textit{(by def:fitness)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:fold}]
Each step of the chain rule is a pure function of two arguments, and composition of pure functions is pure; BLAKE3 is a fixed function, so no nondeterminism enters. \hfill \textit{(by def:chain)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:intauth}]
\code{verify\_chain\_hash} instantiates the key argument with the embedded $k$; any adversary who re-signs a modified $h$ with a self-generated key $k'$ passes this check, so it does not establish authorship. \hfill \textit{(by def:signed)}\\
\code{verify\_chain\_hash\_with\_key} instantiates the key argument with $k^{\star}$; by Ed25519's existential unforgeability, producing a valid $s$ over $h$ under $k^{\star}$ without $sk^{\star}$ is infeasible, so a pass attributes authorship to the holder of $sk^{\star}$. \hfill \textit{(by def:signed)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:mapcommit}]
$\Omega$ carries each frame's committed fields into event attributes; the chain recomputation depends only on these plus \code{payload\_hash} and \code{prev\_chain\_hash}, which the record retains, so the exported log determines $h_n$ and re-verification is the Faithful Chain Theorem applied to the reconstructed frames. \hfill \textit{(by prop:nodrift)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:nodrift}]
There is a single construction site, \code{build\_admission\_frame} and \code{chain\_from\_frame}, invoked by both callers on the record's own fields; function purity forces equal outputs on equal inputs, so a recompute mismatch isolates a field mutation rather than a logic difference. \hfill \textit{(by prop:fold)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:notesledger-op}]
A failing CAS (reference already exists) exits with a non-zero code before touching the notes tree; only the lock holder proceeds. \hfill \textit{(by def:gitlock-op)}\\
If the process is killed after the notes append but before lock release, the lock entry remains; the restart protocol detects a stale lock by comparing the locked OID $H$ to current HEAD, force-releasing it if they differ, since the locked OID no longer uniquely identifies a live critical section. \hfill \textit{(by def:gitlock-op)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:payloadcommit}]
Bytes $[24,56)$ of the body are the eight words $w_0\dots w_7=\dg(p)$ by construction; the map $\dg(p)\mapsto(w_0,\dots,w_7)$ is a little-endian bijection $\{0,1\}^{256}\to(\{0,1\}^{32})^{8}$, so injectivity of $\body$ gives that distinct payload digests induce distinct bodies. \hfill \textit{(by prop:bodyinj)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:prefix}]
Base case: $h_0=\Genesis$. \hfill \textit{(by def:genesis)}\\
Inductive step: $h_t=\chainH(h_{t-1}\concat\body(\fr_t))$ depends on $h_{t-1}$, which by hypothesis commits $\fr_1,\dots,\fr_{t-1}$ and $\Genesis$, and on $\body(\fr_t)$; so $h_t$ depends on all of $\Genesis,\fr_1,\dots,\fr_t$. The collision clause is deferred to the Faithful Chain Theorem. \hfill \textit{(by def:chain)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:conservation}]
Actuation is gated by the equation: an artifact enters $\Act$ only as $\muop(x)$ with $x\ne\Rfsl$, so $\im\muop$ exhausts the actuated set; \code{receipt} is a method available only on \code{LawObject<\_, Admitted, \_>}, so no artifact is receipted without an admitted antecedent. \hfill \textit{(by def:chain)}\\
Each call to \code{chain} increments \code{frame\_count} by one and produces one new \code{chain\_hash}. Suppose two distinct actuations mapped to the same $h_{+}$: their frames differ (distinct \code{instruction\_id} or payload digest), so equal terminal commitments would force a collision by the Faithful Chain Theorem; hence $\Phi$ is injective up to $\varepsilon(\lambda)$. \hfill \textit{(by thm:faithful)}\\
By Construction~\ref{con:commit}, $\dg(x)$ occupies bytes $[24,56)$; the denial word occupies $[16,24)$ and equals ADMITTED on the accept path, so the frame commits both the identity of the cause and the verdict that admitted it. \hfill \textit{(by con:commit)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:faithful}]
Let $j$ be the least index at which $\Ledger,\Ledger'$ differ in a committed field. Bodies are injective on committed fields, so $\body(\fr_j)\ne\body(\fr'_j)$; because $j$ is least, the predecessors agree, $h_{j-1}=h'_{j-1}$. \hfill \textit{(by prop:bodyinj)}\\
The two fold inputs $x=h_{j-1}\concat\body(\fr_j)$ and $x'=h'_{j-1}\concat\body(\fr'_j)$ have equal-length, equal prefixes but differing suffixes, so $x\ne x'$; Construction~\ref{con:commit}'s payload-digest word placement is what makes the suffix differ when only the payload changes. \hfill \textit{(by prop:payloadcommit)}\\
If $h_j\ne h'_j$, Proposition~\ref{prop:prefix} propagates the divergence to the terminal, so $h_n=h'_n$ requires some later fold step to map unequal inputs to equal outputs; if instead $h_j=h'_j$ despite $x\ne x'$, $\chainH(x)=\chainH(x')$ is itself a collision. Either way $h_n=h'_n$ forces a collision, contradicting the collision-resistance axiom up to $\varepsilon(\lambda)$. \hfill \textit{(by ax:cr)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:localize}]
If the mutation malforms a hex field, \code{schema} fails at $j$, since earlier records parse, being unperturbed. \hfill \textit{(by def:pipeline)}\\
If the mutation changes a committed field but leaves \code{chain\_hash\_hex}(j) stale, \code{chain\_recompute} fails at $j$: the recomputation uses the perturbed fields and diverges from the stored value exactly at $j$, since records $<j$ are unperturbed and recompute equal. \hfill \textit{(by prop:nodrift)}\\
If the mutation reorders or splices records so thread continuity breaks, \code{chain\_linkage} fails at the least index whose \code{prev} no longer matches its predecessor's \code{chain\_hash}. \hfill \textit{(by def:pipeline)}\\
If the mutation rewrites both a field and its stored chain hash consistently, either linkage breaks at $j$ unless the entire suffix is rewritten, in which case the forged terminal commitment differs from the attested $h_n$ and the Faithful Chain Theorem applies at the boundary. \hfill \textit{(by thm:faithful)}\\
If the mutation preserves hashes but produces a trace that is not a firing sequence, \code{token\_replay} fails at $j$ with fitness $<1$. In every class the least failing index is $j$, and the honest prefix passes every stage because each stage's predicate on records $<j$ is evaluated on unperturbed data and holds by hypothesis. \hfill \textit{(by def:pipeline)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:scope}]
(A) Integrity is the Faithful Chain Theorem: altering a committed field forces a collision. \hfill \textit{(by thm:faithful)}\\
(B) Attribution is Conservation of Consequence clause (iii) composed with the integrity-vs-authenticity distinction: the frame commits the admitted cause and denial word, and (if signed) the signature commits a keyholder. \hfill \textit{(by thm:conservation)}\\
(C) Conformance-as-checked is the fitness proposition, scoped to the fixed model: fitness certifies conformance to the model that was replayed, not that the model is the correct model. \hfill \textit{(by prop:fitness)}\\
(a) Two ledgers with different obligation sets $G\ne G'$ can both verify; the chain commits $\dg(G)$ so it records which set was used, but verification returns Pass for any committed $G$, so it does not rank $G$ against $G'$. \hfill \textit{(by thm:scope)}\\
(b) Fix any admitted $x$; both a benign and a harmful deterministic $\muop$ produce verifying chains, since verification never inspects the world-consequences of $a=\muop(x)$, only that $a$'s digest is committed. Hence world-fitness is not a function of the verdict. \hfill \textit{(by thm:scope)}\\
(c) By the series' Rice specialization, no computable predicate decides whether $o$ means what it purports; admission is a retraction, not a decision, so a verifying receipt attests admission, provably weaker than truth. \hfill \textit{(by thm:scope)}\\
\end{proof}


\chapter{Planning Geometry}

\begin{construction}[con:join]
\label{con:join}
Grounding with type constraints is a relational join: for a schema parameter $v$ of type $\tau$, the admissible objects are $\{o:\code{TypeIndex::satisfies}(\mathrm{SymId}(o),\mathrm{SymId}(\tau))\}$, walking the parent chain to depth bounded by the height of $\mathcal{T}$, reducing effective branching from $N^k$ to $\prod_i|\{o:\mathrm{type}(o)\le\tau_i\}|$.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:normalize]
\label{con:normalize}
Given a partition part $T'\subseteq T$ with entry places $P_{\text{in}}$ and exit places $P_{\text{out}}$, the sub-net is normalized to a valid WF-net by adding fresh boundary places $p_s,p_e$ and silent transitions $\tau_{\text{in}},\tau_{\text{out}}$, redirecting boundary arcs onto a unified source and sink.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:strips]
\label{con:strips}
Take the places to be the ground atoms; a ground action $t$ with delete-effects $\bm m^{-}_{t}$ and add-effects $\bm m^{+}_{t}$ is a transition, and \code{GroundProblem::find\_plan} searches marking space by BFS with the successor relation exactly transition firing.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:tape]
\label{con:tape}
\code{temporal\_plan\_to\_powl\_tape} converts a \code{TemporalPlan} into a tape of \code{PowlOpSpec}s: each step $i$ becomes an activity with a \code{pred\_mask} of steps $j<i$ finishing before $i$ starts and a one-hot \code{succ\_mask}; a second pass performs transitive reduction, clearing bits of predecessors' own predecessors, leaving only direct predecessors.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:xorf]
\label{con:xorf}
Let $R\subseteq\Obs$ be the reachability fixpoint fact set. A frozen fact store builds an 8-bit XOR filter over FNV-1a hashes of $R$, with index mapping via the fastrange reduction $\mathrm{reduce}(x,n)=(x\times n)/2^{32}$; membership is gated by $x\in B$ if $F(x)=\mathrm{true}$, else false, with false-positive rate $\approx 0.4\%$ and false negatives $0$.
\end{construction}

\begin{corollary}[cor:cert]
\label{cor:cert}
A nonconformance certificate is a single vector $\bm y\in\mathbb{R}^{p}$ together with $\Nmat^{\top}\bm y\le\bm0$ and $\bm y^{\top}\bm b>0$; checking it is a matrix product and two sign tests, independent of trace length, verifiable within a bounded context $\CL$.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:dominate]
\label{cor:dominate}
An admitted plan sorts strictly before any refused plan regardless of its secondary costs: for any finite risk, makespan, token, latency, and switch values, an admitted \code{CostVector} is $\prec_{\mathrm{lex}}$ the refused top element; the price of unlawfulness is infinite in the limit that defines the order.
\end{corollary}

\begin{definition}[def:balance]
\label{def:balance}
A durative action $j$ draws on a fluent $\phi$ if its effect decreases $\phi$ by $r_j$ at start and increases it by $r_j$ at end for rate $r_j\ge0$, holding $r_j$ units over $[s_j,e_j)$; the free level of $\phi$ at time $t$ is $f_\phi(t)=\nu_0(\phi)-\sum_{j:t\in[s_j,e_j)} r_j$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:conf]
\label{def:conf}
A trace with final marking $\bm m^{\dagger}$ and transition-count vector $\bm x$ conforms to a net with initial marking $\bm m_{0}$ if $\bm m^{\dagger}\in\Poly$ and the $\bm x$ witnessing it is realized by a genuine firing ordering; it fails membership if $\bm m^{\dagger}\notin\Poly$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:cost]
\label{def:cost}
The router's \code{CostVector} is the tuple $\CostV=(c_0,\dots,c_5)=(\overline{\code{admitted}},\code{risk},\code{attention\_seconds},\code{tokens},\code{latency},\code{switches})$; the order is lexicographic, cheapest-first, and the refused vector $\code{refused}()=(\text{unadmitted},255,\infty,\infty,\infty,255)$ is the top element.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:domain]
\label{def:domain}
A lifted domain is a tuple $\mathcal{D}=(\mathcal{T},\mathcal{P},\mathcal{F},\mathcal{S})$: a finite type hierarchy $\mathcal{T}$, a finite set $\mathcal{P}$ of predicate symbols, a finite set $\mathcal{F}$ of numeric function symbols (fluents), and a finite set $\mathcal{S}$ of action schemas; a durative schema carries typed parameters, a duration constraint, a condition $C_s$, and an effect $E_s$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fitness]
\label{def:fitness}
On finalization the verifier returns, in Q16.16 fixed point, $\Fitness=|\code{fitted}|/|\code{replayed}|$ and precision $=|\code{replayed}|/(|\code{replayed}|+|\code{enabled\_not\_taken}|)$, where $|\cdot|$ is population count and $\Fitness\coloneqq1$ when the denominator is zero.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:ground]
\label{def:ground}
Given a domain $\mathcal{D}$ and a problem $(\mathcal{Ob},\bm m_{0},\nu_{0},\gamma)$, the grounding substitutes every type-compatible object tuple into each schema's parameters, producing a finite set of ground actions; a grounded state is a pair $(\bm m,\nu)$ of a set $\bm m$ of true ground atoms and a fluent valuation $\nu$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:incidence]
\label{def:incidence}
Let $\Nmat\in\mathbb{Z}^{p\times|T|}$ have column $\bm\delta_t=\bm m^{+}_{t}-\bm m^{-}_{t}$ for each transition $t$; a firing sequence with Parikh vector $\bm x\in\Zplus^{|T|}$ satisfies the state equation $\bm m=\bm m_{0}+\Nmat\bm x$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:makespan]
\label{def:makespan}
Given the precedence DAG with per-op durations $d_i$ and release times, the forward pass computes $\text{es}_i=\max(r_i,\max_{j\prec i}\text{ef}_j)$, $\text{ef}_i=\text{es}_i+d_i$; the makespan is $T=\max_i\text{ef}_i$; the backward pass computes $\text{ls}_i=\text{lf}_i-d_i$; the slack of op $i$ is $\text{ls}_i-\text{es}_i$, and the critical path is the set of zero-slack ops.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:net]
\label{def:net}
A net has $p$ places and a finite set $T$ of transitions; a marking is a vector $\bm m\in\Zplus^{p}$; a transition $t$ is a pair $(\bm m^{-}_{t},\bm m^{+}_{t})$ of preset and postset, enabled at $\bm m$ iff $\bm m\ge\bm m^{-}_{t}$ coordinatewise, firing to $\bm m'=\bm m-\bm m^{-}_{t}+\bm m^{+}_{t}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:polytope]
\label{def:polytope}
The marking polytope of a net is the relaxation $\Poly=\{\bm m_{0}+\Nmat\bm x:\bm x\ge\bm0\}\cap\{\bm m\ge\bm0\}\subseteq\Rplus^{p}$, the continuous translated cone whose integer points over-approximate the reachable set.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:powl]
\label{def:powl}
A POWL model over an activity alphabet $A$ is one of: an activity $a\in A$ (a leaf); a partial order $(\{M_1,\dots,M_k\},\prec)$ executed by respecting $\prec$ and running incomparable children concurrently; or a choice graph $(\{M_1,\dots,M_k\},E)$ combined by exclusive choice (and cyclic/loop edges), taking exactly one live branch.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:replay]
\label{def:replay}
The verifier holds a marking $\bm m$ (\code{enabled\_tokens}) initialized to the entry token, and accumulators \code{replayed}, \code{fitted}, \code{enabled\_not\_taken}; replaying a frame rejects an invalid node bit, requires $\bm m\ge\bm m^{-}$, records enabled-but-unconsumed tokens, fires $\bm m\gets(\bm m\ \&\ \lnot\bm m^{-})\ |\ \bm m^{+}$, and sets the node bit in \code{replayed} and \code{fitted}.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:saturation]
\label{def:saturation}
Let $(\mathcal{D},\mathcal{Ob})$ be a grounded PDDL problem with initial atom set $\bm m_0$ and ground action set $T$. The Nemo Datalog program $\Pi$ has one fact per atom in $\bm m_0$ and one rule per ground action; the saturation $\mathrm{sat}(\Pi)$ is the least fixpoint $\mathrm{lfp}(T_\Pi)$ of the immediate-consequence operator; an atom $p$ is reachable iff $p\in\mathrm{sat}(\Pi)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:symdict]
\label{def:symdict}
A symbol identifier $\mathrm{SymId}\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ is a compact integer encoding of a ground atom or object name; \code{pddl-index} maintains a bidirectional map $\code{SymDict}:\{\text{strings}\}\leftrightarrow\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$, encoded forward as \code{FxHashMap<String,u32>} and reverse as \code{Vec<String>}; zero is reserved as undefined.
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:balance]
\label{prop:balance}
A durative-action schedule is feasible with respect to $\phi$ iff $f_\phi(t)\ge0$ for all $t$; for the unit-rate attention fluent this says the number of concurrently in-flight capabilities never exceeds the capacity $\nu_0(\code{attention})$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:cone]
\label{prop:cone}
Every marking $\bm m$ reachable from $\bm m_{0}$ satisfies the state equation for some $\bm x\in\Zplus^{|T|}$, hence lies in the integer points of $\bm m_{0}+\cone(\Nmat)$ intersected with $\Zplus^{p}$; the state equation is necessary for reachability but not sufficient.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:conserve]
\label{prop:conserve}
If every action drawing on $\phi$ both decrements it by $r_j$ at start and increments it by $r_j$ at end, the net effect of each completed action on $\phi$ is zero, and the terminal valuation equals the initial: $\nu_{\text{end}}(\phi)=\nu_0(\phi)$; scheduling redistributes when $\phi$ is held, never how much exists.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:critical]
\label{prop:critical}
The makespan $T$ equals the length of the longest ($\prec$-)path in the precedence DAG weighted by durations, and an op has zero slack iff it lies on some longest path; delaying a zero-slack op delays the makespan, delaying an op by less than its slack does not.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:dictcost]
\label{prop:dictcost}
With symbol dictionary encoding, a ground atom $p(o_1,\dots,o_k)$ is a tuple of $k+1$ $\mathrm{SymId}$ values; equality reduces to integer comparison and hash-set membership to a single hash over $4(k+1)$ bytes, so the grounding loop's cost with encoding replaces $O(|T|\cdot k\cdot N)$ string comparisons with $O(1)$-time integer counterparts.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:hasse]
\label{prop:hasse}
Let $\prec$ be the strict order "$j$ finishes before $i$ starts" on plan steps. The initialized \code{pred\_mask} of step $i$ is $\{j:j\prec i\}$, and after transitive reduction it is the covering relation of $\prec$; the resulting dependency graph is a DAG, and two steps are schedulable concurrently iff $\prec$-incomparable.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:honest]
\label{prop:honest}
$\Fitness$ and precision are ratios of bit-populations of disjointly-maintained bitsets; neither can exceed $1$, and $\Fitness=1$ is attained exactly on completed replays; \code{enabled\_not\_taken} feeds precision, not fitness, so the two metrics measure orthogonal deviations.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:local]
\label{prop:local}
In a POWL model, the token marking local to a node ranges over the tokens of that node's immediate children: a node of arity $k$ has a local marking space of dimension $O(k)$, independent of the total size of the model; a node's replay is checked in a working set bounded by its arity.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:quarantine]
\label{prop:quarantine}
Let $\text{sep}$ be the decidable predicate "the net is sound and separable." It is a legitimate admission obligation: total and computable, retracting the space of arbitrary control-flow onto the decidable sub-language of POWL-expressible processes; a separable net is admitted, a non-separable net is refused with reason.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:safe]
\label{prop:safe}
On a safe (1-bounded) net, the integer firing rule $\bm m'=\bm m-\bm m^{-}_{t}+\bm m^{+}_{t}$ coincides with the branchless bitset update $\code{enabled\_tokens}\gets(\code{enabled\_tokens}\ \&\ \lnot\bm m^{-}_{t})\ |\ \bm m^{+}_{t}$, and the enabling test coincides with the branchless subset check $(\code{enabled}\ \&\ \bm m^{-}_{t})\oplus\bm m^{-}_{t}=0$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:satcorrect]
\label{prop:satcorrect}
$p\in\mathrm{sat}(\Pi)$ iff there exists a sequence of ground actions whose add-effects include $p$, i.e.\ $p$ is reachable from $\bm m_0$ in the Petri-net sense.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:sensitivity]
\label{prop:sensitivity}
Let $T(\phi=c)$ be the makespan the planner finds when fluent $\phi$'s initial capacity is $c$. The capacity delta reports $(T(c-1),T(c),T(c+1))$, and $\phi$ is binding iff $T(c-1)\neq T(c)$ (or the problem is infeasible at $c-1$); this is a finite-difference sensitivity of the specific schedule the greedy planner produced, not a dual shadow price of an optimal scheduler.
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[thm:bounded-ground]
\label{thm:bounded-ground}
Let $\mathcal{D}$ have schemas of maximum parameter arity $k$ over $|\mathcal{Ob}|=N$ objects. The number of ground actions is at most $|\mathcal{S}|\cdot N^{k}$, a finite constant independent of the goal; consequently a forward search over grounded actions has a branching factor bounded a priori, and $\muop$'s manufacture terminates within a fixed depth bound.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:farkas]
\label{thm:farkas}
Fix $\bm b=\bm m^{\dagger}-\bm m_{0}$. Exactly one holds: (a) there exists $\bm x\ge\bm0$ with $\Nmat\bm x=\bm b$; or (b) there exists $\bm y\in\mathbb{R}^{p}$ with $\Nmat^{\top}\bm y\le\bm0$ and $\bm y^{\top}\bm b>0$, a separating hyperplane certifying $\bm m^{\dagger}\notin\bm m_{0}+\cone(\Nmat)$, and if (b) holds no firing sequence reaches $\bm m^{\dagger}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:fitness]
\label{thm:fitness}
Replaying a sequence of frames against the net either (i) completes with no violation, in which case it is a genuine firing sequence and $\Fitness=1$; or (ii) halts at the first frame whose preset is not contained in the current marking, returning a coordinate-localized witness of the earliest disabled transition.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:lang-correct]
\label{thm:lang-correct}
Let $N$ be a safe and sound workflow net, and let $\psi=\text{convert}(N)$ be its POWL 2.0 conversion. Then for any prefix trace length $k$, $\mathcal{L}_k(N)=\mathcal{L}_k(\psi)=\mathcal{L}_k(\text{recompose}(\psi))$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:lex]
\label{thm:lex}
Let secondary coordinates be bounded, $|c_i|\le M$ for $i\ge1$. Define $C_\lambda(\CostV)=\sum_{i=0}^{5}\lambda^{5-i}c_i$ with $\lambda>1$. There is a threshold $\Lambda$ such that for all $\lambda>\Lambda$, $\CostV\preceq_{\mathrm{lex}}\CostV' \iff C_\lambda(\CostV)\le C_\lambda(\CostV')$; as $\lambda\to\infty$ the weight on $c_0$ diverges relative to all others.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:mrr]
\label{thm:mrr}
Let $A$ be a set of independent client accounts, $\text{realized}(a)$ the revenue of account $a$ under a target stage, and $\text{lawful\_targets}(a)$ its evidence-gated target stages. The joint plan optimization decomposes linearly: $\max_{\text{joint plan}}\sum_{a\in A}\text{realized}(a)=\sum_{a\in A}\max_{t\in\text{lawful\_targets}(a)}\text{realized}(a,t)$, reducing search complexity from $\Omega(\prod_a|T_a|)$ to $O(|A|\cdot|T_a|)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:sep]
\label{thm:sep}
A sound, separable workflow net admits a recursive decomposition into a POWL model whose every internal node is a partial order or a choice graph and whose leaves are activities, with each node's local marking geometry dimension bounded by its arity, independent of the global net size.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:cert}]
Verification reads $\bm y$ and $\bm b$ and evaluates $\Nmat^{\top}\bm y$ and $\bm y^{\top}\bm b$; the cost is $O(p\cdot|T|)$ in the net's fixed dimensions, with no dependence on trace length or interior computation. \hfill \textit{(by thm:farkas)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:dominate}]
The lead coordinate $c_0$ is $0$ for admitted and $1$ for refused, and by Theorem~\ref{thm:lex} it dominates: any admitted vector differs from the refused element first at $c_0$, where it is strictly smaller. \hfill \textit{(by thm:lex)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:balance}]
The start guard at $s_j$ requires $\nu(\phi)\ge r_j$ in the state just before $j$'s at-start decrement, so the guard holds iff $f_\phi(s_j)\ge0$; free level changes only at action starts and ends, so nonnegativity at every start implies it everywhere, and a violated guard is an instant with $f_\phi<0$. \hfill \textit{(by def:balance)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:cone}]
Firing $t$ once adds column $\bm\delta_t$ to the marking; a sequence firing each $t$ exactly $x_t$ times adds $\sum_t x_t\bm\delta_t=\Nmat\bm x$, giving the state equation, and since each $x_t\ge0$ and markings are nonnegative integers, $\bm m$ is an integer point of $\bm m_0+\cone(\Nmat)$. \hfill \textit{(by def:net)}\\
Insufficiency is the classical Petri-net fact: the state equation ignores intermediate nonnegativity and firing order, so spurious solutions exist. \hfill \textit{(by prop:cone)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:conserve}]
\code{Decrease}$(\phi,r_j)$ then \code{Increase}$(\phi,r_j)$ compose to the identity on $\nu(\phi)$; summing over all completed actions, the total change is $\sum_j(r_j-r_j)=0$, so $\nu_{\text{end}}(\phi)=\nu_0(\phi)$. \hfill \textit{(by def:balance)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:critical}]
The forward recursion $\text{ef}_i=\text{es}_i+d_i$ with $\text{es}_i=\max_{j\prec i}\text{ef}_j$ is the standard longest-path dynamic program over a DAG, so $T=\max_i\text{ef}_i$ is the overall longest path; the backward pass gives the latest each op may start without increasing $T$, and slack $0$ iff $i$ lies on a longest path. \hfill \textit{(by def:makespan)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:dictcost}]
Each parameter binding substitutes an object's $\mathrm{SymId}$ (an $O(1)$ lookup in a \code{Vec}) for a parameter name; forming the atom tuple is $O(k)$ integer writes, and the hash of a tuple of $32$-bit integers is computed by FxHash in $O(k)$ time independent of string lengths. \hfill \textit{(by def:symdict)}\\
Summing over $|T|$ schemas and $N^k$ bindings gives the stated cost. \hfill \textit{(by thm:bounded-ground)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:hasse}]
$\prec$ is irreflexive and transitive, induced by the total order on real finish/start times, hence a strict partial order; the first pass sets bit $j$ in $i$'s mask exactly when $j\prec i$. \hfill \textit{(by con:tape)}\\
The reduction clears bit $j$ from $i$'s mask when some retained predecessor $k$ of $i$ has $j$ in its predecessors, i.e.\ $j\prec k\prec i$; what survives is precisely the covering relation (the Hasse diagram) of $\prec$. \hfill \textit{(by con:tape)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:honest}]
Population count is monotone and bounded by the number of node bits, and \code{fitted}$\subseteq$\code{replayed} by construction, so $\Fitness\le1$. \hfill \textit{(by def:replay)}\\
Equality holds iff no frame was replayed-without-fitting, which is every completed replay; \code{enabled\_not\_taken} is updated only in step (3) and read only by precision's denominator, so it is independent of the fitness numerator. \hfill \textit{(by thm:fitness)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:local}]
A node's execution semantics reference only its own children's tokens: a partial order gates on the $\prec$-predecessors among its $k$ children, a choice gates on which of its $k$ branches is live, so the token bits touched by one node's firing are contained in an $O(k)$-dimensional subspace. \hfill \textit{(by def:powl)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:quarantine}]
Soundness and separability are structural properties of a finite net, checkable by the decomposition procedure, which either returns a POWL tree or the node at which decomposition fails; thus $\text{sep}$ is total and computable. \hfill \textit{(by thm:sep)}\\
Admission maps the net to its POWL decomposition when $\text{sep}=1$ and to refusal with the obstruction as refusal data otherwise, exactly the admission map specialized to processes. \hfill \textit{(by thm:sep)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:safe}]
On $0/1$ markings with $\bm m^{-}_t\le\bm m$, the AND-NOT clears exactly the consumed places and the OR with $\bm m^{+}_t$ sets the produced places; when preset and postset are disjoint from the retained marking this is bit-for-bit the integer expression. \hfill \textit{(by def:net)}\\
The enabling identity holds because $(\bm m\ \&\ \bm m^{-})\oplus\bm m^{-}=0$ iff every bit of $\bm m^{-}$ is also set in $\bm m$, i.e.\ $\bm m\ge\bm m^{-}$ coordinatewise on $0/1$ vectors. \hfill \textit{(by con:strips)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:satcorrect}]
Soundness: every derived atom is the add-effect of a ground action whose preconditions were derived earlier, by induction on the derivation depth; the actions form a witness firing sequence. \hfill \textit{(by def:saturation)}\\
Completeness: a reachable atom has a witness sequence; unrolling it gives a derivation in $T_\Pi$, the standard Datalog fixpoint theorem applied to the grounded action rules. \hfill \textit{(by prop:satcorrect)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:sensitivity}]
\code{replan\_with\_perturbed\_capacity} re-solves \code{find\_temporal\_plan} with $\phi$'s initial value moved by $\pm1$ and reads off the resulting makespan; \code{binding\_resource\_mask} sets bit $i$ iff the $-1$ perturbation changed the makespan or made the problem infeasible. \hfill \textit{(by def:makespan)}\\
Infeasibility at $c-1$ is itself evidence the resource binds. \hfill \textit{(by prop:balance)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:bounded-ground}]
Each schema binds at most $k$ parameters, each to one of $\le N$ objects, so it grounds to at most $N^{k}$ actions; summing over $|\mathcal{S}|$ schemas gives the bound. \hfill \textit{(by def:ground)}\\
In \code{bcinr-pddl} the count is additionally capped by \code{PDDL8\_MAX\_GROUND}, exceeding it is \code{Pddl8Error::BoundExceeded}, so the ground action set is finite and its size is a fixed function of $(|\mathcal{S}|,N,k)$, discharging boundedness (M2). \hfill \textit{(by def:ground)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:farkas}]
This is Farkas' lemma applied to the system $\Nmat\bm x=\bm b,\ \bm x\ge\bm0$: either the system has a nonnegative solution, or there is $\bm y$ with $\bm y^{\top}\Nmat\le\bm0^{\top}$ and $\bm y^{\top}\bm b>0$, and never both. \hfill \textit{(by thm:farkas)}\\
In case (b), if a firing sequence reached $\bm m^{\dagger}$, its Parikh vector $\bm x^{\star}\ge\bm0$ satisfies $\Nmat\bm x^{\star}=\bm b$, so $\bm y^{\top}\bm b=(\Nmat^{\top}\bm y)^{\top}\bm x^{\star}\le0$, contradicting $\bm y^{\top}\bm b>0$; hence (b) rules out reachability. \hfill \textit{(by prop:cone)}\\
Soundness is one-directional: feasibility of the relaxation (a) is necessary but not sufficient for an actual firing sequence, so (a) does not by itself certify conformance --- only (b) certifies its negation. \hfill \textit{(by prop:cone)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:fitness}]
Step (2) of the replay definition admits a frame iff $\bm m\ge\bm m^{-}$, which is exactly the enabling condition; by induction on the prefix, if no frame is rejected then every frame fired from a marking at which it was enabled, so the whole sequence is a genuine firing sequence. \hfill \textit{(by def:replay)}\\
Step (4) is the firing rule of the safe-net specialization. \hfill \textit{(by prop:safe)}\\
In the completing case every replayed frame also sets \code{fitted}, so $|\code{fitted}|=|\code{replayed}|$ and $\Fitness=1$; conversely the guard fails at the first frame whose required tokens are absent, returning immediately with that frame's node id, the localized witness. \hfill \textit{(by def:fitness)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:lex}]
If $\CostV\prec_{\mathrm{lex}}\CostV'$ they first differ at coordinate $p$ with $c'_p-c_p\ge\epsilon>0$; then $C_\lambda(\CostV')-C_\lambda(\CostV)\ge\lambda^{5-p}\epsilon-2M(\lambda^{5-p}-1)/(\lambda-1)$, positive once $\lambda>\Lambda\coloneqq1+2M\cdot6/\epsilon$, so the scalarization order agrees with $\preceq_{\mathrm{lex}}$ for $\lambda>\Lambda$. \hfill \textit{(by def:cost)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:sep}]
This is the decomposition established for POWL by Kourani and van der Aalst and colleagues, resting on van der Aalst's process-mining foundations; cited rather than reproved here. \hfill \textit{(by thm:sep)}\\
\end{proof}


\chapter{Projection and Scale}

\begin{construction}[con:agent8]
\label{con:agent8}
Project each agent $a$ to a status byte $\abyte(a)\in\{0,1\}^8$ whose lanes are the OK-polarity complements of the denial lanes (admitted, evidence, budget, authority, healthy, conformant, receipted, replayable); $\mathbf1=\code{0xFF}$ is the all-OK byte; an agent is admissible iff $\abyte(a)=\mathbf1$, equivalently iff its 8-lane denial restriction is $\bm0$.
\end{construction}
