\begin{construction}[con:swar]
\label{con:swar}
For a denial word $w\in\{0,1\}^{64}$ of eight 8-bit lanes with $L_{\text{high}}=\code{0x8080808080808080}$ and $L_{\text{low7}}=\code{0x7f7f7f7f7f7f7f7f}$, the zero-lane bitmask is $z(w)=\lnot(((w\&L_{\text{low7}})+L_{\text{low7}})\lor w)\&L_{\text{high}}$; bit 7 of lane $j$ in $z(w)$ is 1 iff lane $j$ in $w$ is exactly \code{0x00}.
\end{construction}

\begin{corollary}[cor:diag]
\label{cor:diag}
Under the Mutant Kill Theorem, the index of the killing stage certifies which law-bearing invariant a mutation broke; a non-empty surviving set that is not equivalent-mutants is a proof that the frame under-commits, the Faithful Projection converse.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:onedenial]
\label{cor:onedenial}
In denial polarity, with $D_\ell=\lnot P_\ell$ the 64-agent word of denial lane $\ell$, the denied set is $\bigvee_\ell D_\ell$ and the admitted set its complement; fleet admission is the word-parallel join of denial lanes followed by one complement, and adding a ninth lane costs one more AND (resp. OR) per 64 agents.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:onlybit]
\label{cor:onlybit}
A planetary control plane that re-admits its population continuously cannot be built on comprehension: no attainable accelerator fleet closes the demand gap; it can be built on the sweep, whose cost is dominated by a single pass over $10\,\mathrm{GB}$ of memory; comprehension is reserved for sampled audit at honest $O(n)$ replay cost.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:reflexive]
\label{cor:reflexive}
Each quantitative claim in this paper is either a theorem with a proof or an Estimate explicitly labelled with its inputs; the partition is exhaustive, so this paper's overclaim set is empty, and by the magnitude theorem the magnitude of each claim is bounded by its witness as the invariant requires.
\end{corollary}

\begin{corollary}[cor:throughput]
\label{cor:throughput}
A single commodity server admits $N=10^{10}$ agents in $\sim25$--$100\,\mathrm{ms}$, i.e. at $\sim10^{11}$--$4\times10^{11}$ agent-admission decisions per second per server, bandwidth-bound.
\end{corollary}

\begin{definition}[def:astgate]
\label{def:astgate}
An AST gate is a syntactic predicate $g:\mathcal T\to\{0,1\}$ on an abstract syntax tree $\mathcal T$, computable in $O(|\mathcal T|)$ time; the retrofit applier gates every proposed change through an ordered battery $(g_1,\dots,g_m)$: the change is admitted iff all gates pass, $\bigwedge_i g_i(\mathcal T)=1$; a failing gate returns a denial with the gate index and offending AST node.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:claim]
\label{def:claim}
A claim is a pair $c=(\phi_c,w_c)$ where $\phi_c$ is a proposition and $w_c\in\mathbb{R}_{\ge0}$ its asserted magnitude; a receipt witness for $c$ is a receipt $r(c)$ whose boundary projection is accepted, $V(\Proj(r(c)))=1$, and whose committed fields entail an attested magnitude $\widehat w_c$; a claim is admissible iff it has a receipt witness with $w_c\le\widehat w_c$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:diff]
\label{def:diff}
For $f,g:D\to R$ targeting the same $S$, the differential oracle is $\Omega_{f,g}(x)=[f(x)=g(x)]$; a test passes at $x$ iff $\Omega_{f,g}(x)=1$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fuzz]
\label{def:fuzz}
For the total admission retraction $\adm:\Obs\rightharpoonup\Adm\cup\{\Rfsl\}$, the fuzzing oracle $\Omega_\partial$ maps generated $o\in\Obs$ to $1$ iff $\adm(o)$ terminates and yields either an admitted $x\in\Adm$ with well-formed artifact $\muop(x)$ or a refusal $\Rfsl$ carrying a category in the eight-bucket taxonomy; $\Omega_\partial(o)=0$ iff $\adm$ crashes, diverges, or returns an unlabelled outcome.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:instance-q]
\label{def:instance-q}
For an executed manufacture $\sigma$: $T(\sigma)$, the interior token count (measured, a count of logged records); $\CL$, the boundary field count of the receipt projection $\Proj(\sigma)$ (a design constant); $t_{\chainH}$, the per-frame recomputation wall-time (estimated from published hash throughput, not measured here).
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:layouts]
\label{def:layouts}
The array-of-structures (AoS) layout stores each agent's 8-bit byte contiguously, a 64-bit word holding 8 agents' bytes; the structure-of-arrays (SoA / bit-plane) layout stores each lane $\ell$ as its own bitset $P_\ell\in\{0,1\}^N$, a 64-bit word of $P_\ell$ holding the lane-$\ell$ bit of 64 agents.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:mut]
\label{def:mut}
A mutation operator $m$ maps a valid subject $s^\star\in\bigcap_i I_i$ to a mutant $m(s^\star)$ violating a non-empty set of invariants; its correct stage is $\stg(m)=\min\{i:m(s^\star)\notin I_i\}$; $m$ is killed by $V$, written $\Kill(m)=1$, iff $V$ rejects $m(s^\star)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:oracle]
\label{def:oracle}
For implementation $f:D\to R$ and specification $S\subseteq D\times R$, the correctness question is $Q_S(f)\equiv\forall x\,(x,f(x))\in S$; a decidable oracle for $f$ on finite $X\subseteq D$ is a total computable predicate $\Omega:X\to\{0,1\}$ intended to witness $(x,f(x))\in S$, terminating on every $x\in X$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:over]
\label{def:over}
The overclaim set of a system emitting claims $\mathcal C$ is $\Over=\{c\in\mathcal C:\nexists\,r(c)\text{ with }V(\Proj(r(c)))=1\text{ and }w_c\le\widehat w_c\}$; the antibody invariant is $\Over=\varnothing$, the \code{docs-exceed-mechanism} defect class enforced as a gate.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:residual]
\label{def:residual}
For environmental observations $O$ and target artifact $A$, the measurement $\muop(O)$ returns a residual vector $R\in\mathbb{R}^k$ with $r_i=\text{measured}_i-\text{midpoint}(\text{target}_i)$; reconciliation selects the dominant dimension $\arg\max_i|r_i|$ and applies a repair operator subject to \code{RepairBand} limits.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:staged]
\label{def:staged}
A staged validator is a pipeline $V=(V_1,\dots,V_k)$ where each stage $V_i:\mathcal{S}\to\{\text{pass}\}\cup\{\text{reject}_i\}$ tests a decidable invariant $I_i\subseteq\mathcal{S}$; the pipeline accepts $s$ iff $s\in\bigcap_i I_i$, reporting on rejection the least $i$ with $s\notin I_i$. Stage $V_i$ is sound if $V_i(s)=\text{reject}_i\Rightarrow s\notin I_i$ and complete if $s\notin I_i\Rightarrow V_i(s)=\text{reject}_i$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:vizgap]
\label{def:vizgap}
A visual gap report is the output of \code{measure\_gap}: for each reconcilable dimension $i\in\{1,\dots,k\}$, the residual $r_i=\text{measured}_i-\text{midpoint}(\text{target}_i)$ and the dominant dimension $i^\star=\argmax_i|r_i|$ together with a rendered diff block; the report has $k$ residual values and one dominant index, size $O(k)$ independent of the interior.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:worktree]
\label{def:worktree}
An applier isolates modifications by spawning a decoupled working tree via \code{git worktree add temp\_path phase\_branch}, running validation gates and executing the auto-rollback protocol \code{git reset --hard baseline\_sha} on failure to guarantee main branch cleanliness.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:worktree-ret]
\label{def:worktree-ret}
The retrofit applier isolates each application attempt in a fresh Git worktree, applies the change, runs the CI oracle $(g_1,\dots,g_m)$ (\code{cargo build}, \code{cargo test}, \code{cargo clippy}), and on any gate failure executes \code{git reset --hard baseline\_sha}; on all-pass the worktree change is merged and the chain receipt for the application is minted with the worktree OID committed into the frame's \code{obj\_refs} payload digest.
\end{definition}

\begin{estimate}[est:bit-supply]
\label{est:bit-supply}
One commodity server supplies $\sim10^{11}$ decisions/s bandwidth-bound; a rack of $\sim10^2$ servers supplies $\sim10^{13}$ decisions/s, $\sim10^7\times$ cheaper per decision than an LLM judgment, so bit-parallel supply scales into the demand band on a single facility.
\end{estimate}

\begin{estimate}[est:comp-supply]
\label{est:comp-supply}
A comprehension-based admission decision costs $\sim10^{-2}$--$10^0\,\mathrm{s}$ of accelerator time, i.e. $\sim1$--$10^2$ decisions/s per accelerator; a planetary fleet of $\sim10^6$--$10^7$ accelerators yields a comprehension-supply ceiling $\Lambda_{\text{comp}}\lesssim10^7$--$10^9$ decisions/s, central estimate $\sim10^8$ decisions/s.
\end{estimate}

\begin{estimate}[est:demand]
\label{est:demand}
For a population $N\in[10^9,10^{12}]$ agents each re-admitted at rate $\rho\in[1,10^2]\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$, aggregate admission demand is $\Lambda_{\text{demand}}=N\rho\in[10^9,10^{14}]$ decisions/s, central estimate $\sim10^{11}$--$10^{12}$ decisions/s for $N\sim10^{10}$, $\rho\sim10$.
\end{estimate}

\begin{estimate}[est:sweep]
\label{est:sweep}
A full admission sweep reads all 8 planes once ($10\,\mathrm{GB}$) and performs $7N/64\approx1.1\times10^{9}$ AND instructions for $N=10^{10}$; at streaming bandwidth $\Bw\sim10^2$--$4\times10^2\,\mathrm{GB/s}$, $t_{\text{sweep}}\approx10\,\mathrm{GB}/\Bw\approx25$--$100\,\mathrm{ms}$; the instruction count is exact, the wall-time is an order-of-magnitude estimate.
\end{estimate}

\begin{estimate}[est:wall]
\label{est:wall}
At BLAKE3 throughput $1$--$3\,\mathrm{GB/s}$/core and a few-hundred-byte frame, $t_{\chainH}\sim10^{-7}\,\mathrm{s}$/frame; a four-field boundary compare is $\ll10^{-7}\,\mathrm{s}$; per-message verification with $c\sim10$ spot frames costs $\sim10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s}$; these are order-of-magnitude estimates, the constancy-in-$T$ point is the proved Proposition~\ref{prop:invariance}.
\end{estimate}

\begin{proposition}[prop:astterm]
\label{prop:astterm}
For any finite AST $\mathcal T$ and finite gate battery $(g_1,\dots,g_m)$ of syntactic predicates, battery evaluation terminates in $O(m\cdot|\mathcal T|)$ time and returns either \code{Admitted} or a refusal carrying the first failing gate index and offending node; the retraction is total, never diverging and never returning an unlabelled outcome.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:diff-bound]
\label{prop:diff-bound}
Under independent errors at rates $p_f,p_g$ with wrong outputs drawn from $\ge M$ distinguishable values with collision probability $\le1/M$: $\Pr[\Omega_{f,g}(x)=1\wedge(x,f(x))\notin S]\le p_f p_g/M$; over a corpus of size $n$ the probability some silent-agreement error survives all $n$ tests is at most $np_f p_g/M$, and a fixed silently-wrong input missed with per-input hit rate $q$ has miss probability $(1-q)^n\to0$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:footprint]
\label{prop:footprint}
A population of $N=10^{10}$ agents, each an 8-bit byte, occupies $N\times8$ bits $=N$ bytes $=10^{10}$ bytes $=10\,\mathrm{GB}$ in either layout; this is an exact arithmetic identity, not an estimate.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:fuzz]
\label{prop:fuzz}
If $\adm$ is total and terminating with codomain $\Adm\cup\{\Rfsl\}$ and $\Rfsl$ is refusal-with-category, then for every $o\in\Obs$, $\Omega_\partial(o)=1$, and any observed $\Omega_\partial(o)=0$ is a genuine defect in the retraction, not a property of the input.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:invariance]
\label{prop:invariance}
For manufactures $\{\sigma_i\}$ sharing the frame schema with $T(\sigma_i)\to\infty$, $\mathrm{Ver}_\partial(\sigma_i)=\Theta(\CL)$ is constant in $i$, and the estimated per-message wall-time $\CL\cdot t_{\text{cmp}}+c\cdot t_{\chainH}$ does not depend on $T(\sigma_i)$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:mainclean]
\label{prop:mainclean}
Under the isolated worktree applier, the main branch is never advanced past a failing CI gate; the rollback protocol is unconditional on failure, running before the worktree is removed, restoring the branch to \code{baseline\_sha} regardless of which gate failed; hence the main branch satisfies all CI gates at every point in its history.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:necessity]
\label{prop:necessity}
For $S$ a non-trivial semantic property, $Q_S(f)$ is undecidable; hence no procedure decides $Q_S(f)$ for arbitrary $f$, and any mechanical trust in $f$ must be trust in some $\Omega$ evaluated on finite $X$, plus an argument bounding residual risk on $D\setminus X$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:vizgap]
\label{prop:vizgap}
The visual gap report gives $\mathrm{gap}:\mathbb R^k\to\mathbb R^k\times[k]$, a projection with the same cost structure as the receipt projection, $O(k)$ to compute and $O(k)$ to verify; the repair operator acts on the dominant dimension $i^\star$ subject to \code{RepairBand} bounds, producing at most one corrective actuation, a bounded deterministic manufacture.
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[thm:afford]
\label{thm:afford}
For demand $\Lambda_{\text{demand}}$ and supplies $\Lambda_{\text{comp}},\Lambda_{\text{bit}}$: $\Lambda_{\text{comp}}\sim10^8\ll\Lambda_{\text{demand}}\sim10^{11}$--$10^{12}\lesssim\Lambda_{\text{bit}}\sim10^{11}$--$10^{13}$; comprehension-based admission is under-provisioned by three to four orders of magnitude for a $10^{10}$-agent fleet, while bit-parallel admission meets demand on a single facility, and the separation persists under an order-of-magnitude perturbation of any single input.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:branchless]
\label{thm:branchless}
Under the SoA layout, the admissibility of 64 agents is computed by the single branchless word expression $\mathsf{adm}=P_1\&\cdots\&P_8$; bit $j$ of $\mathsf{adm}$ is 1 iff agent $j$ has all eight lanes OK; the computation uses exactly 7 AND instructions, no data-dependent branch, and processes 64 agents, cost $7/64\approx0.11$ instructions per agent.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:instance-gap]
\label{thm:instance-gap}
For comprehension cost $\mathrm{Comp}(\sigma)=\Theta(T(\sigma))$ and boundary-verification cost $\mathrm{Ver}_\partial(\sigma)=\Theta(\CL)$, the instance ratio is $\Theta(T(\sigma)/\CL)=\Theta(2.5\times10^{6}/4)\approx 6.25\times10^{5}$; both inputs are measured/design constants, so the ratio is a measured consequence, not an estimate.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:kill]
\label{thm:kill}
For a staged validator $V=(V_1,\dots,V_k)$ in which every stage is sound and complete, and a mutation operator $m$ with correct stage $\stg(m)$: $\Kill(m)=1\iff V_{\stg(m)}$ rejects $m(s^\star)$, and the least rejecting stage reported by $V$ equals $\stg(m)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:magnitude]
\label{thm:magnitude}
If a system maintains $\Over=\varnothing$, then for every emitted claim $c$, $w_c\le\widehat w_c=\max\{w:\text{the committed fields of }r(c)\text{ entail magnitude }w\}$, verifiable at boundary cost $O(\CL)$ independent of the interior that produced $c$; no claim can exceed what its mechanism can receipt.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:swar-verify]
\label{thm:swar-verify}
For a 64-bit word $w$ packing 8 agents gated against the broadcast required mask, the number of admitted agents is $\text{admitted}(w)=\code{popcount}(z(w))$, sweeping 8 agents in one CPU instruction with zero branches and no lane borrow leakage.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{cor:reflexive}]
The gap ratio, the footprint, the per-word gating, and the magnitude bound itself are theorems with proofs. \hfill \textit{(by thm:magnitude)}\\
The wall-time, sweep time, demand, supplies, and affordability separation are labelled estimates carrying their inputs; every magnitude falls in one class or the other, none unlabelled, hence $\Over=\varnothing$ for this document. \hfill \textit{(by def:over)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:astterm}]
Each $g_i$ traverses the finite tree once in $O(|\mathcal T|)$ time; the battery evaluates gates in order, returning the structured denial on first failure or \code{Admitted} on all-pass; each gate result composes as a denial-monoid element. \hfill \textit{(by def:astgate)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:diff-bound}]
A false accept at $x$ requires $f$ wrong and $g(x)=f(x)$, probability $\le p_f p_g/M$ by independence and the collision bound; the union bound over $n$ corpus points gives $np_f p_g/M$; the miss bound is the probability a Bernoulli-$q$ trigger never fires in $n$ draws, $(1-q)^n$. \hfill \textit{(by def:diff)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:footprint}]
Eight bits is one byte; $N$ agents is $N$ bytes; $10^{10}$ bytes is $10\,\mathrm{GB}$; both layouts store the same $8N$ bits, hence the same $N$ bytes; no estimated quantity appears. \hfill \textit{(by con:agent8)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:fuzz}]
Totality gives termination on all $o$; the closed codomain gives, for each $o$, either $x\in\Adm$ with $\muop(x)$ defined, or $\Rfsl$ with a category, since every refusal path maps through the wildcard-free classifier; thus $\Omega_\partial\equiv1$ on a correct implementation, and an observed $0$ contradicts totality or closedness, witnessing a defect. \hfill \textit{(by def:fuzz)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:invariance}]
The projection has codomain of size $\le\CL$ and the verifier reads only $\Proj(\sigma_i)$; neither the field count nor the verifier's input size is a function of $T$; a spot-check recomputes a fixed number $c$ of $O(1)$ frames, so its cost is $c\cdot t_{\chainH}$, independent of $T$. \hfill \textit{(by def:instance-q)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:mainclean}]
The applier's critical section creates the worktree, applies the change, runs the gate battery, and on failure resets to \code{baseline\_sha} and aborts before the worktree is deleted; the main branch pointer advances only on the pass branch, so the main branch history is a subsequence of attempts that all passed every gate. \hfill \textit{(by def:worktree-ret)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:necessity}]
$Q_S(f)$ quantifies a non-trivial semantic predicate over the language computed by $f$; by Rice's theorem it is undecidable; a total $\Omega$ on finite $X$ always terminates and so is not a decision procedure for $Q_S$, but a retraction onto the decidable fragment ``$f$ passes $\Omega$ on $X$''; trust in $f$ factors through $\Omega$ and $X$. \hfill \textit{(by prop:necessity)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:vizgap}]
The residual vector is a linear map costing $O(k)$ arithmetic operations; the argmax is a single pass over $k$ values; the repair acts on that one dimension only, and since \code{RepairBand} is a finite closed interval, the repair is a bounded projection onto that interval. \hfill \textit{(by def:vizgap)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:afford}]
The comprehension ceiling $\Lambda_{\text{comp}}\sim10^8$ falls short of demand $\sim10^{11}$--$10^{12}$ by $10^3$--$10^4$. \hfill \textit{(by est:comp-supply)}\\
The bit-parallel supply meets or exceeds demand; the gap between the two supplies is the keystone's per-decision cost ratio scaled by population. \hfill \textit{(by est:bit-supply)}\\
A tenfold error in any one input (population, rate, per-decision cost, accelerator count) moves the inequality by at most one decade and does not reverse the three-to-four decade comprehension shortfall. \hfill \textit{(by est:demand)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:branchless}]
Agent $a_j$ is admissible iff $\bigwedge_{\ell=1}^8\abyte(a_j)_\ell=1$. \hfill \textit{(by con:agent8)}\\
Bit $j$ of $P_\ell$ equals $\abyte(a_j)_\ell$ by the SoA definition; bitwise AND acts coordinatewise, so bit $j$ of $P_1\&\cdots\&P_8$ equals $\bigwedge_\ell\abyte(a_j)_\ell$, which is 1 iff $a_j$ is admissible; a left-fold of AND over 8 operands is 7 binary ANDs, branchless, giving per-agent cost $7/64$. \hfill \textit{(by def:layouts)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:instance-gap}]
Comprehension must ingest $\Theta(T(\sigma))$ tokens; boundary verification reads the $\CL=4$ receipt fields and applies the fixed verifier. \hfill \textit{(by def:instance-q)}\\
The quotient is $T/\CL$; substituting $T\approx2.5\times10^6$, $\CL=4$ gives $\approx6.25\times10^5$, immediate from the keystone's Theorem 4.2; no estimated quantity enters. \hfill \textit{(by thm:instance-gap)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:kill}]
($\Leftarrow$) If $V_{\stg(m)}$ rejects $m(s^\star)$ then $V$ rejects, so $\Kill(m)=1$. \hfill \textit{(by def:mut)}\\
($\Rightarrow$) If $\Kill(m)=1$, let $j$ be the least rejecting stage; by soundness of $V_j$, $m(s^\star)\notin I_j$; by completeness of $V_1,\dots,V_{j-1}$, none of which rejected, $m(s^\star)\in I_i$ for all $i<j$; hence $j=\stg(m)$, and $V$'s reported least rejecting index equals $\stg(m)$. \hfill \textit{(by def:staged)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:magnitude}]
By $\Over=\varnothing$, every emitted $c$ has a receipt witness with $V(\Proj(r(c)))=1$ and $w_c\le\widehat w_c$; a claim with $w_c>\widehat w_c$ would lie in $\Over$, contradicting the invariant; hence $w_c\le\widehat w_c$, a bound independent of the unread interior. \hfill \textit{(by def:over)}\\
\end{proof}


\chapter{Projection Thesis}

\begin{axiom}[ax:obs]
\label{ax:obs}
There is a set $\Obs$, the observation space, whose elements are arbitrary finite records: logs, agent outputs, sensor frames, claims, tool responses. $\Obs$ carries no decidable semantics: ``does this observation mean what it purports to mean'' is not assumed computable.
\end{axiom}

\begin{construction}[con:agent8]
\label{con:agent8}
Project each agent to a status byte $b\in\{0,1\}^8$ whose lanes name admitted, evidence-ok, within-budget, authority-bound, healthy, conformant, receipted, replayable. A fleet of $N$ agents is a bit-packed vector; a $64$-bit word holds $8$ agents; a fleet admission sweep is the branchless mask reduction of the denial construction applied word-parallel.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:denial]
\label{con:denial}
Let $D=(\{0,1\}^n,\lor,\bm 0)$ be the commutative idempotent monoid of denial words: $n$ independent lanes, componentwise OR, identity $\bm 0$. Each obligation $g_i$ contributes a lane map $d_i:\Obs\to\{0,1\}^n$ with $d_i(o)=\bm 0\iff g_i(o)=1$. The total denial is $d(o)=\bigvee_i d_i(o)$, and $\adm(o)\ne\Rfsl\iff d(o)=\bm 0$.
\end{construction}

\begin{corollary}[cor:noncomp]
\label{cor:noncomp}
An accepting verifier's predicate factors as $\mathrm{Verify}=V\circ\Proj$ for a fixed $V:\Recs\to\{0,1\}$ of input size $\le\CL$. Trust in the accept is a function of the $\CL$-sized projection and the soundness of $V$, not of any agent's comprehension of $\sigma$.
\end{corollary}

\begin{definition}[def:adm]
\label{def:adm}
Fix a decidable $\Adm\subseteq\Obs$ on which a finite battery of obligations $g_1,\dots,g_m:\Obs\to\{0,1\}$ is computable. The admission map is the partial retraction $\adm:\Obs\rightharpoonup\Adm\cup\{\Rfsl\}$, $\adm(o)=\rho(o)\in\Adm$ if $\bigwedge_i g_i(o)=1$, else $\Rfsl$, with $\rho$ a computable bounding/normalization and $\Rfsl$ the distinguished refusal. Admission is idempotent on its image: $\adm\circ\adm=\adm$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:attnbalance]
\label{def:attnbalance}
Let $c(t)\ge0$ be capacity and admitted action $j$ draw rate $r_j\ge0$ on $[s_j,e_j]$. Free capacity is $f(t)=c(t)-\sum_{j:\,t\in[s_j,e_j]}r_j$. A schedule is feasible iff $f(t)\ge0$ for all $t$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:costvector]
\label{def:costvector}
Assign a plan $\bm c=(c_0,c_1,\dots,c_k)$, $c_0\in\{0,1\}$ the unadmitted indicator ($0=$ admitted), $c_1,\dots,c_k$ bounded secondary costs. Order by lexicographic $\preceq_{\mathrm{lex}}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fitnessdistance]
\label{def:fitnessdistance}
$\Fitness(\sigma)=1-\dfrac{\text{tokens consumed on unenabled transitions}}{\text{tokens the replay attempted to consume}}\in[0,1]$; $\Fitness=1$ iff the replay never forced a disabled firing, and $1-\Fitness$ is a normalized $\ell^1$ excursion outside the enabled set.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:mu]
\label{def:mu}
$\muop:\Adm\to\Act$ is a deterministic computable map subject to (M1) determinism/reproducibility: $\muop(x)$ depends only on $x$, equal admitted inputs give bit-identical artifacts; and (M2) boundedness: $\muop$ factors through a representation of size bounded by fixed structural constants, so $\muop$ terminates with a priori bounded cost. The Chatman equation is $\Act=\muop(\Adm)$, operationally $a=\muop(\adm(o))$ when $\adm(o)\ne\Rfsl$, and $\muop(\Rfsl)=\Rfsl$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:reachcone]
\label{def:reachcone}
Let $N\in\mathbb Z^{p\times|T|}$ have columns $\bm\delta_t=\bm m^+_t-\bm m^-_t$. A firing sequence with Parikh vector $\bm x\ge0$ reaches $\bm m=\bm m_0+N\bm x$. The reachable set lies in the integer points of $\bm m_0+\operatorname{cone}(N)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:receipt]
\label{def:receipt}
Fix a collision-resistant hash $\chainH:\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^{256}$ and write $\dg(\cdot)=\chainH(\cdot)$. For a manufacture with admitted observation $x=\adm(o)$, obligation set $G$ with denial word $d(o)$, transition identity $\tau$, artifact $a=\muop(x)$, replay result $\Fitness$, refusal reason $r$, and implementation version $v$, the frame is $\mathsf{fr}=\langle\dg(x),\dg(G),d(o),\tau,\dg(a),\Fitness,r,v\rangle$, and the chained receipt advances by $h_{+}=\chainH(h_{-}\Vert\mathsf{fr})$. The receipt projection is $\Proj:\Sigma\to\Recs$, $\Proj(\sigma)=(\text{verdict},h_{+},\Fitness,r)$, a tuple of at most $\CL$ chunks.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:regimes]
\label{def:regimes}
For a trace of $n$ committed frames: boundary projection inspection (any verifier, per message) costs $O(\CL)$; single frame recomputation (spot check) costs $O(1)$ per frame; checkpointed/indexed replay (sampled audit) costs $O(\log n)$ or bounded path; full chain replay (full audit) costs $O(n)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:attnconservation]
\label{prop:attnconservation}
Total attention $\int_0^T\!\sum_j r_j\mathbf 1_{[s_j,e_j]}(t)\,dt=\sum_j r_j(e_j-s_j)$ is independent of ordering. Reordering redistributes \emph{when} attention is spent, not \emph{how much}; the optimization target is the makespan functional $T[\cdot]$ under precedence and the pointwise capacity constraint.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:conformembership]
\label{prop:conformembership}
A trace with Parikh vector $\bm x$ is conformant only if its marking lies in $\mathcal P=\{\bm m_0+N\bm x:\bm x\ge\bm0\}\cap\{\bm m\ge\bm0\}$. If $\bm m^\dagger\notin\mathcal P$, Farkas' lemma yields $\bm y$ with $\bm y^\top N\le\bm0$ and $\bm y^\top(\bm m^\dagger-\bm m_0)>0$: a certificate of nonconformance.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:planetary]
\label{prop:planetary}
For a fleet of $N$ agents under Construction~\ref{con:agent8}: (a) arithmetic -- the status vector occupies exactly $N$ bytes, packed to $N/8$ 64-bit words; a full admission sweep is $N/8$ masked-OR word operations. (b) engineering estimate -- compressed status is $\sim\!10\,\mathrm{GB}$; a sweep takes $\Theta(N/(8B))$ wall-clock. (c) order-of-magnitude estimate -- the affordability ratio between one cache-line mask op and one LLM admission decision is $\sim\!10^{7}$. (d) consequence, not theorem -- a comprehension-based or per-agent-LLM planetary control plane is infeasible by $\sim\!N\cdot10^{7}$, while a bit-parallel admission sweep is feasible.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:selfauditedscale]
\label{prop:selfauditedscale}
Let a system emit claims $c$ with receipts $r(c)$, and define the overclaim set $\mathrm{Over}=\{c:\nexists\,r(c)\text{ with }V(\Proj)=1\}$. If the system enforces $\mathrm{Over}=\varnothing$ (the \textsf{docs-exceed-mechanism} defect class), the admissible magnitude of a claim is bounded by the mechanism that receipts its limits, not by rhetoric.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:semilattice]
\label{prop:semilattice}
$(\{0,1\}^n,\lor)$ is the join-semilattice of $2^{[n]}$ with bottom $\bm 0$. Adding obligations only enlarges denials: for $G'\supseteq G$, $d_{G'}(o)\succeq d_G(o)$, so $\{o:\adm_{G'}(o)\ne\Rfsl\}\subseteq\{o:\adm_G(o)\ne\Rfsl\}$.
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[thm:conservation]
\label{thm:conservation}
(i) Causation: every actuated artifact $a$ is the image of at least one admitted observation, $a\in\im\muop$, and no $a\notin\im\muop$ is actuated. (ii) Position uniqueness: each actuation appends exactly one receipt-chain position; the map $\text{actuation}\mapsto h_+$ is injective up to hash collision. (iii) Observation recoverability / commitment: if $\muop$ is injective on $\Adm$, the artifact determines the admitted observation (recoverability); otherwise, when the frame commits $\dg(x)$, the receipt position uniquely commits to $(\dg(x),\dg(G),\tau,\dg(a))$ (commitment, not semantic recovery).
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:faithful]
\label{thm:faithful}
The receipt is faithful to lawful consequence exactly to the extent the frame commits its fields: for any committed field $\phi\in\{\dg(x),\dg(G),d(o),\tau,\dg(a),\Fitness,r,v\}$, producing a trace $\sigma'$ that differs in $\phi$ yet matches the claimed $h_+$ requires a collision of $\chainH$; under collision resistance a verifier who recomputes the chain rejects any such $\sigma'$ except with negligible probability. Conversely, fields not committed by the frame are not attested.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:gap]
\label{thm:gap}
Let $\mathrm{Comp}(\sigma)=\Theta(\dim\Sigma)$ be the cost of comprehending the interior and $\mathrm{Ver}_{\partial}(\sigma)=O(\CL)$ the cost of boundary verification of $\Proj(\sigma)$. Then $\mathrm{Comp}(\sigma)/\mathrm{Ver}_{\partial}(\sigma)=\Omega(\dim\Sigma/\CL)\to\infty$ as $\dim\Sigma\to\infty$, while boundary verification stays constant; replay and full audit honestly cost $O(n)$, reducible to $O(\log n)$ under checkpoint indexing.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:lex]
\label{thm:lex}
With $C_\lambda(\bm c)=\sum_{i=0}^k\lambda^{k-i}c_i$, $\lambda>1$, $|c_i|\le M$: there is $\Lambda$ with $\bm c\preceq_{\mathrm{lex}}\bm c'\iff C_\lambda(\bm c)\le C_\lambda(\bm c')$ for all $\lambda>\Lambda$. As $\lambda\to\infty$ the lawfulness coordinate's weight diverges.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:rice]
\label{thm:rice}
Let $P$ be any non-trivial semantic property of the meanings observations may encode. Then $\{o\in\Obs : P(o)\}$ is undecidable.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:sep]
\label{thm:sep}
A sound, separable workflow net admits a recursive decomposition into a POWL~2.0 model whose every node is a choice graph (all exclusive/cyclic logic) or a partial order (all concurrent logic); each node's local marking geometry has dimension bounded by its arity, independent of global net size.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[thm:unitfitness]
\label{thm:unitfitness}
A trace is a firing sequence iff $\Fitness=1$. If $\Fitness<1$, the first frame forcing an unenabled consumption is a coordinate-localized witness $t^\star$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:attnconservation}]
Linearity of the integral; each $r_j(e_j-s_j)$ depends only on $j$'s duration and rate. \hfill \textit{(by def:attnbalance)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:conformembership}]
Membership is the state equation with $\bm x\ge0$; Farkas applied to $N\bm x=\bm m^\dagger-\bm m_0,\ \bm x\ge0$ gives either a nonnegative solution or the separating $\bm y$. \hfill \textit{(by def:reachcone)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:planetary}]
(a) is counting: the status vector occupies exactly $N$ bytes by construction of the per-agent status byte. \hfill \textit{(by con:agent8)}\\
(b),(c) are estimates and are marked as such; they depend on hardware and workload and are not claimed as theorems. \hfill \textit{(by con:agent8)}\\
(d) is the engineering consequence of composing (a) with the Fleet Trust Budget corollary: per-message cost $O(\CL)$ versus $\Omega(\dim\Sigma)$ for comprehension, scaled by $N$. No part of this proposition asserts a mathematical impossibility; it asserts an economic separation under stated estimates. \hfill \textit{(by thm:gap)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:selfauditedscale}]
Every admissible claim has a faithful receipt, verifiable at $O(\CL)$; a claim lacking one is in $\mathrm{Over}$ and rejected by the invariant. Admissible claims are exactly receipted claims. \hfill \textit{(by thm:gap)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:semilattice}]
Idempotence, commutativity, associativity of $\lor$ per coordinate; products of semilattices are semilattices. \hfill \textit{(by con:denial)}\\
$d_{G'}(o)=d_G(o)\lor\bigvee_{i\in G'\setminus G}d_i(o)\succeq d_G(o)$, and $\bm 0$ is the unique minimum. \hfill \textit{(by con:denial)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:conservation}]
Actuation is gated by the Chatman equation: $a$ actuates only if $a=\muop(x)$, $x=\adm(o)\ne\Rfsl$; thus $\im\muop$ exhausts the actuated set and its complement never actuates. 'At least one' is all determinism yields, since $\muop$ need not be injective. \hfill \textit{(by def:mu)}\\
The chain appends one position per manufacture; distinct positions with equal $h_+$ force a collision. \hfill \textit{(by thm:faithful)}\\
If $\muop$ is injective on $\Adm$, then $a=\muop(x)$ determines $x$ outright -- recoverability. Otherwise, because $\mathsf{fr}$ contains $\dg(x)$, the frame -- hence $h_+$ -- commits the observation digest; by collision resistance no second $x'$ with $\dg(x')\ne\dg(x)$ shares the position, so the receipt uniquely commits to the digest tuple. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:faithful}]
Each field appears as an argument to $\chainH$ inside $\mathsf{fr}$, and $h_-$ commits all predecessors recursively, so $h_+$ is a function of every committed field of the entire causal history. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
If $\sigma'$ differs in a committed $\phi$ but the recomputed chain equals the claimed $h_+$, then some application of $\chainH$ took distinct inputs to equal outputs -- a collision -- which has negligible probability. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
If $\sigma'$ differs only in a field absent from $\mathsf{fr}$, the chain is unchanged and the difference is, correctly, not attested: the theorem claims faithfulness precisely over committed fields, no more. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
Drop $\dg(x)$ or $d(o)$ from the frame and the same proof yields only byte-tamper-evidence, establishing that lawfulness attestation requires the law-bearing commitments. \hfill \textit{(by def:receipt)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:gap}]
$\mathrm{Ver}_\partial$ reads $\Proj(\sigma)$ of size $\le\CL$ and applies $V$: $O(\CL)$. \hfill \textit{(by cor:noncomp)}\\
$\mathrm{Comp}$ must ingest the interior of size $\Theta(\dim\Sigma)$. The ratio diverges. \hfill \textit{(by def:regimes)}\\
The scope clause restates the verification-regimes definition: mechanical replay is $O(n)$, not $O(1)$; the constant-cost claim is confined to boundary inspection. \hfill \textit{(by def:regimes)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:lex}]
If $\bm c\prec_{\mathrm{lex}}\bm c'$ they first differ at $p$ with $c'_p-c_p\ge\epsilon>0$; then $C_\lambda(\bm c')-C_\lambda(\bm c)\ge\lambda^{k-p}\epsilon-2M\sum_{i>p}\lambda^{k-i}$, positive once $\lambda>\Lambda=1+2Mk/\epsilon$. \hfill \textit{(by def:costvector)}\\
Ties map to equality. \hfill \textit{(by thm:lex)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:rice}]
Rice's theorem: every non-trivial property of the language recognized by a Turing machine is undecidable. Observations are unrestricted encodings and may encode arbitrary machines; any non-trivial semantic predicate inherits undecidability by reduction from the halting problem. \hfill \textit{(by ax:obs)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:unitfitness}]
Enabled firings never force consumption, giving numerator $0$ and, inductively, a genuine firing sequence within $\mathcal P$. A disabled event records a forced consumption at the earliest index $t^\star$, making the numerator positive. \hfill \textit{(by def:fitnessdistance)}\\
\end{proof}


\chapter{Synthesis Thesis}

\begin{construction}[con:fablechain]
\label{con:fablechain}
When $\mathrm{Oracle}(T,R)=1$, the harness mints a receipt using the standard \code{OcelCausalFrame} chain: $h_{+} = \chainH(h_{-}\,\Vert\,\mathrm{body}(\fr))$, where the frame's \code{obj\_refs} carry $\dg(C)=\chainH(\text{canonical bytes of }C)$. The genesis seed is $\chainH(\text{``fable-v1-genesis''})$, domain-isolated from the plan chain so fable receipts cannot cross-verify with plan receipts even if their terminal hashes collide.
\end{construction}

\begin{construction}[con:merklecell]
\label{con:merklecell}
Let $M_{g,i}$ be the terminal hash of member $i$ in group $g$. The Group Receipt hash is $H_g = \chainH(\text{sort}(\{M_{g,i}\}))$, and the Cell Receipt hash is the rolling fold over $G$ group hashes: $H_{\text{cell}} = \chainH(H_1\,\Vert\,H_2\,\Vert\,\dots\,\Vert\,H_G)$.
\end{construction}

\begin{definition}[def:branch]
\label{def:branch}
A branch is $(c, \Sigma, r)$: a class, a conjunction of signal predicates over a crash snapshot, and a lawful response $r \in \{\textsf{Restart}, \textsf{Park}(\rho), \textsf{Refuse}(\mathrm{core}), \textsf{Escalate}\}$. The geometry $\Geo$ maps each node to an ordered branch list; classification is first-match-wins; $\mathrm{geometry\_hash} = \ca(\Geo\,\Vert\,\mathrm{topology\_hash})$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:classes]
\label{def:classes}
$\mathsf{FailureClass} = \{$\textsf{LogicFault}, \textsf{BudgetBreach}, \textsf{AuthorityVacuum}, \textsf{TransientFault}, \textsf{Stall}, \textsf{StarvedInput}, \textsf{CertifiedUnsat}, \textsf{GeometryGap}$\}$ -- the semantic axis, capped at eight by the doctrine.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:depth]
\label{def:depth}
Let $\Dag = (V, E)$ be the plan's data-dependency DAG (edge $u \to v$ iff an add-effect of $u$ feeds a precondition of $v$); define $d(v) = 0$ for sources and $d(v) = 1 + \max_{u \to v} d(u)$ otherwise. A stage $S_k = \{v : d(v) = k\}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:earned]
\label{def:earned}
Stage $S_k$ supervises \textsc{RestForOne} iff some $v \in S_k$ has a nonempty transitive dependent set $D(v)$; otherwise \textsc{OneForOne}. The cohort of $v$ is $\{v\} \cup D(v)$ under \textsc{RestForOne} and $\{v\}$ under \textsc{OneForOne}.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fable]
\label{def:fable}
A Fable harness is a test environment that constructs a prompt $P_T$ from a task ontology $T$, calls a mock model membrane $M$ that intercepts the LLM API and returns a deterministic response drawn from a test fixture indexed by $P_T$'s hash, extracts the code block $C$ from the model response $R$, and runs the verification oracle $\mathrm{Oracle}(T,R)$ against $C$ in an isolated cargo workspace. The mock membrane ensures that harness runs are hermetic: no real LLM call is made, the response is deterministic given $P_T$, and the oracle verdict is reproducible.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:fragile]
\label{def:fragile}
A precondition predicate $p$ of capability $c$ is fragile iff no capability in the problem produces $p$. The initial state is a one-time gift: if a fragile fact is lost mid-run, nothing in the plan can lawfully re-produce it -- whereas a fact with even one producer is recoverable by restarting that producer.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:sandbox]
\label{def:sandbox}
Let $P_T$ be a prompt compiled from task ontology $T$, and let $C$ be the code block extracted from model response $R$. The sandbox verification oracle is the composite: $\text{Oracle}(T, R) = \text{cargo\_build}(C) \land \text{cargo\_test}(C) \land \text{cargo\_clippy}(C) \land \text{safety\_audit}(C)$. The outcome is receipted and chained to the ledger using rolling BLAKE3 hashes.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[def:walframe]
\label{def:walframe}
A cache frame journaling the memoized DAG nodes is serialized as a length-prefixed frame: $\text{WAL\_Frame} = \langle\,\text{length},\ \chainH(\text{payload}),\ \text{payload}\,\rangle$, allowing recovery to discard torn frames.
\end{definition}

\begin{lineage}[lineage:actorlineage]
\label{lineage:actorlineage}
The 8-bounded actor lineage (CNS -> BitActor -> ByteActor -> knhk): CNS fixed the doctrine 8T/8H/8M; ByteActor V3 productized it with 64-byte crystal envelopes and bounded SPSC rings; knhk carried the doctrine into Rust with a branchless TickBudget, a ChatmanBounded assertion, and an R1/W1/C1 runtime-class taxonomy. The lineage's one persistent gap never closed: classification without actuation -- nothing in the constellation restarts, re-admits, or closes the loop.
\end{lineage}

\begin{lineage}[lineage:armstrong]
\label{lineage:armstrong}
Erlang/OTP made three moves that survive every re-examination: processes are isolated so failure cannot spread by memory; supervisors -- not the failing code -- own the recovery decision; and restart strategies plus a restart intensity turn `let it crash' into a bounded, structured discipline. What OTP does not do is derive the tree: a human writes the supervision hierarchy, and the crash space lives in the programmer's head.
\end{lineage}

\begin{lineage}[lineage:instruments]
\label{lineage:instruments}
The LHC does not record every collision; its trigger system encodes, in advance, the signatures of events worth keeping. The EHT did not photograph a black hole; it reconstructed one from lawful projections gathered by an instrument designed around a predicted signal. The discipline common to both: enumerate the event geometry before the event, instrument for exactly those signatures, and treat anything outside the geometry as a first-class finding -- never as noise to be discarded silently.
\end{lineage}

\begin{measurement}[meas:cell]
\label{meas:cell}
The supervised cell, 10,000 members, release: overhead of supervision at fault rate 0 is $-0.9\%$ of medians over five paired runs, inside the baseline's own $\pm 5.7\%$ run spread -- statistical noise. Recovery counts track injected transient rates exactly: $69 / 608 / 3{,}179$ recovered at $1\% / 10\% / 50\%$. Throughput is flat across all fault rates. The crash-looping template is detected at quorum and quarantined by epoch 2 in every configuration.
\end{measurement}

\begin{measurement}[meas:recoveryinvisible]
\label{meas:recoveryinvisible}
On the lawobject plan with two injected transient crashes at judge: both crashes land in named branches (TransientFault, then Stall), the run completes, and the final root hash is byte-identical to the crash-free run's. Park-then-re-admit heals to the same identity; machine death composes: kill-9 mid-restart-loop, WAL recovery, identical receipt.
\end{measurement}

\begin{proposition}[prop:fable-oracle]
\label{prop:fable-oracle}
$\mathrm{Oracle}(T,R)$ is a decidable oracle for the correctness question "does $C$ implement $T$ correctly?" on the finite test corpus generated by the harness: it is total, terminating, and labelling (pass or fail with a structured error from the failing stage).
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:topology]
\label{prop:topology}
$\Topo = (\mathrm{stages}, \mathrm{policy})$ is produced only by \textsf{derive} (a sealed constructor: no literal construction compiles), and $\mathrm{topology\_hash} = \ca(\mathrm{stages}\,\Vert\,\mathrm{policy}\,\Vert\,\mathrm{plan\_hash}\,\Vert\,\mathrm{problem\_hash})$ joins the receipt lineage. Determinism is test-pinned: same plan, same hash.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[prop:totalaccounting]
\label{prop:totalaccounting}
Every node of every supervised run carries exactly one disposition (\textsf{Completed}$(r)$, \textsf{Parked}, \textsf{SkippedBy}, \textsf{GaveUp}); no silent rows exist (test-pinned: $|\mathrm{dispositions}| = |V|$).
\end{proposition}

\begin{refusal}[ref:curve]
\label{ref:curve}
No novelty-curve-under-faults measurement -- yet: member-level fault injection recovers without re-running solver work, so a work-proxy re-measurement would overstate the cache dividend -- the flattering error. The claim is withheld until node-level injection is wired through the fleet path; the receipt file names this in its own deferred list.
\end{refusal}

\begin{refusal}[refusal:noknhkpath]
\label{refusal:noknhkpath}
No path dependencies on knhk: verified by live probes, recorded as the standing reason -- the leanest candidate crate drags tokio/reqwest/opentelemetry transitively; the mu-kernel ships property-testing libraries as regular dependencies and uses unsafe transmutes; the workspace does not build as a whole. Ports of 50--200-line designs, tagged PORT(knhk) with per-item deltas, cost less than the supply chain. Drift is greppable.
\end{refusal}

\begin{refusal}[refusal:nomeasuredticks]
\label{refusal:nomeasuredticks}
No measured CPU ticks: knhk's own hot receipts carried dummy tick values behind a hardcoded 4 GHz assumption. Declared deterministic costs (Ticks as an abstract unit) are the honest model for a planner; rdtsc instrumentation is a bench follow-up, documented as a divergence, not smuggled in as a claim.
\end{refusal}

\begin{refusal}[refusal:oneforall]
\label{refusal:oneforall}
No \textsc{OneForAll}: OTP justifies one-for-all by shared mutable fate between siblings. In an acyclic data-flow plan, same-depth siblings are independent by construction -- the coupling one-for-all encodes is inexpressible. The variant does not appear in the Strategy enum at all; an exhaustive-match test makes its future addition a compilation event, forcing the doctrine conversation.
\end{refusal}

\begin{refusal}[refusal:simpleoneforone]
\label{refusal:simpleoneforone}
No \textsc{SimpleOneForOne}; intensity $> 8$ refused, not clamped: derived plans have static step sets, and \texttt{RestartPolicy::new(9, \_)} returns a Refusal -- the byte governor applies to recovery itself, and silently clamping a stated policy would be the executor editing the operator's law.
\end{refusal}

\begin{refusal}[refusal:v1scope]
\label{refusal:v1scope}
v1 scope: beat scheduling, full R1/W1/C1 SLO matrix, quarantine parole, supra-cell supervision. Each receipted with salvage: the enum and one tier transition ship; epoch boundaries already provide the re-admission cadence beats would refine; quarantined classes await a parole mechanism; cells supervising cells is the composition step after this one.
\end{refusal}

\begin{remark}[remark:flatthroughput]
\label{remark:flatthroughput}
What flat throughput means: the cost of a supervised fleet tracked its failure novelty, not its failure rate: recovered transients are absorbed at boundary cost, and the one genuinely novel pathology (the crash-looping class) was converted --- once, by quorum --- into a cheap standing refusal. The full novelty-curve-under-faults re-measurement is receipted as deferred, not claimed.
\end{remark}

\begin{remark}[remark:mockmembranes]
\label{remark:mockmembranes}
Mock membranes as differential oracles: the mock membrane produces responses from test fixtures; a real-model run produces a different response. Running both and comparing (differential oracle) bounds the false-accept rate: an implementation error that passes the oracle with the mock response but fails with the real response is caught by the differential.
\end{remark}

\begin{theorem}[thm:gap]
\label{thm:gap}
\textsf{GeometryGap} is the value classification returns when no stored branch matches; it is never a member of any stored list. Consequently no branch ordering, addition, or deletion can capture, mask, or remove the gap outcome: the map admits its own incompleteness by construction, not by convention.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{prop:fable-oracle}]
Each stage of the oracle (cargo build, cargo test, cargo clippy, safety audit) terminates on every finite $C$; the codomain of each stage is $\{0,1\}\times\mathrm{ErrInfo}$, a total finite type; a failure at any stage short-circuits with the stage index and its ErrInfo, analogous to the staged validator of Paper 04's Definition 4.7. \hfill \textit{(by prop:fable-oracle)}\\
Hence Oracle is total and terminating, and by Proposition 4.4 of Paper 04 any observed failure is a genuine defect in $C$, not a property of the oracle. \hfill \textit{(by prop:fable-oracle)}\\
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \ref{thm:gap}]
An unstorable value cannot be shadowed by stored values, and first-match-wins terminates in the implicit case exactly when all stored matches fail. \hfill \textit{(by def:branch)}\\
The enforcement is the derivation function's type: branch lists are built from a constructor set that excludes the gap class. \hfill \textit{(by def:branch)}\\
\end{proof}
